title: Officer- Numeracy
Senior Manager - Curriculum & Pedagogy (Remote)
description:
About Udhyam:
   

  

 Udhyam Learning Foundation (Udhyam) is on a mission towards Making Bharat Entrepreneurial. We believe that entrepreneurial mindsets are a powerful way to channelize an individual’s potential as they enable agency and allow an individual to work on their strengths while creating value for the world.
   

  

 Our programs:
   

  

* Udhyam Shiksha works on developing entrepreneurial mindsets among the youth in the government high schools and enabling them to achieve their potential, having impacted :24,00,000 learners across 10 Indian states.
* Udhyam Vyapaar focuses on nano businesses in India, and solving large problems faced by them, at scale; having already enabled up to a 27% income uplift for 5000\+ entrepreneurs.


 Udhyam Shiksha’s Program Model:
   

  

 Udhyam Shiksha works in collaboration with the state governments to implement the Entrepreneurial Mindset Curriculum (EMC) in grades 9th to 12th. EMC is designed to build agency in learners by providing real world learning opportunities to high school students across 4 years. EMC is designed on the foundations of experiential learning and encourages learners to make choices, work in teams, go out of their comfort zones and try new experiences.
   

  

 About the role:
   

  

 Building a curriculum that genuinely nurtures student agency inside the government education system is a deeply iterative act of design. It requires moving past what looks good on paper to what actually changes how a student thinks, chooses, and acts. We believe that student agency isn't taught through content alone; it is designed into the structure of every learning experience, task, and interaction a student has with the curriculum.
   

  

 At the same time, curriculum quality at scale is shaped by persistent tensions between what research says should work and what the ground tells us actually does, between designing for one context and designing for hundreds of diverse ones. As a result, there is often a gap between curriculum that is well\-researched and curriculum that produces real shifts in students.
   

  

 This role is for someone who has spent time wrestling with these tensions and developed a grounded point of view on what makes learning design travel from a good idea to a classroom reality. You know how to question your own assumptions, test them against evidence from the field, and iterate without losing sight of the bigger idea you're building toward. You've seen the cost of designing in isolation from users, and you've built instincts for co\-designing with teachers and students rather than for them.
   

  

 This means treating every design choice as a hypothesis: naming the assumption it rests on, building in the evidence that would prove it wrong, and having the discipline to revise it when the ground tells you something different. It also means benchmarking relentlessly against high\-performing systems and emerging research so that what we build here holds up not just locally, but against the best in the world.
   

  

 At Udhyam, we are designing within real constraints\- the realities of government school classrooms, teacher workload, diverse contexts, and the discipline scale demands. This role requires someone who can hold conceptual ambition and ground\-level pragmatism at once: someone who prototypes early, tests with real teachers and students, and treats classroom observation as a primary source of truth.
   

  

 Sitting at the heart of the curriculum and pedagogy team, you will own the curriculum design vertical—questioning assumptions before designing, building learning experiences that create real shifts in student thinking, and institutionalising a culture of evidence\-backed iteration across the team. You will work closely with the teacher development lead, M\&E, state operations partners, and SCERT stakeholders, and contribute to shaping what excellent, agency\-building curriculum design can look like within public education systems in India.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Research and Design
+ Articulate the objectives of curriculum design at different stages and lead the design processes by designing frameworks, leading reviews of designs.
+ Standardize the design process and protocols across grades and designers/
+ Research best practices in experiential learning, adolescent learning, entrepreneurial mindsets to continuously improve the design.
+ Ensure and model high quality user feedback.
+ Generate learning questions and hypotheses to observe the program efficacy on ground.
+ Visit programs during implementation to gather insights \& learn.

* Implementation/Program Management:
+ Collaborate with
- the SCERT and Ops teams to align on the curriculum design and implementation.
- The M \& E team to interpret data and its integration, review assessments etc.
- the product and tech teams for deeper student engagement and dissemination of designs.

* Team Development and management:
+ Facilitate defining the scope of work and KRs of your team clearly.
+ Ensure smooth alignment of your team with other teams.
+ Coach the team on their developmental needs.
+ Deepen skill and conviction of the team on design behaviours.

* Curriculum Leadership
+ Co\-work with the director and other leads in identifying goals/priorities, standardising design processes and facilitating cross learning within the team.
+ Lead curriculum team processes in the absence of the curriculum director.
+ Hire and induct new people in the team.


 Skills, Experience and Mindsets:
   

  

* At least 12\+ years of work experience in designing for scale at scale, curriculum design for public schools
* Having worked in a classroom setting for a few years would be an added plus
* Deep knowledge about theories of experiential learning, adolescent learning
* Ability to research, analyse data \& articulate specific problems
* Ability to observe and assess the needs of users
* Skilled as a facilitator of small and large groups
* Highly creative \& entrepreneurial
* Functional ability to speak and write in hindi

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Instaplay is a lifestyle brand based in NCR that specializes in consumer electronics. We create experiences that resonate with customers and envision building a community of "Instaplayerz". We wish to build Instant products which WoW consumers like a magic!!
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




  





 You will own InstaPlay's growth on online marketplaces end to end. The job is to find where sales can grow, get the right people at each platform to back us, and fix the operational problems that quietly kill revenue. You'll work directly with the founders and have real say in budgets, pricing and channel priorities.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




  





 \- Own GMV, net revenue and contribution margin across Amazon, Flipkart and other relevant platforms (Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, JioMart, Tata CLiQ, and quick commerce where it fits).
 



  





 \- Build working relationships with category and account managers at each platform. Get us into deals, banners and sale events like Big Billion Days, Prime Day and Great Indian Festival.
 



  





 \- Run marketplace ads (Amazon Ads, Flipkart PLA/PCA) against clear ROAS and TACoS targets. Kill spend that doesn't pay back \- Manage catalog quality: listings, A\+ content, images, keywords, pricing and reviews.
 



  





 \- Plan inventory with ops to avoid stock\-outs and aged stock across FBA, Flipkart Smart and seller\-fulfilled models .
 



  





 \- Handle account health, returns, claims, reimbursements and payment reconciliation. Recover money the platforms owe us.
 



  





 \- Track competitor pricing, assortment and ad activity, and act on it weekly.
 



  





 \- Send a weekly dashboard to the founders: sales, margin, ad efficiency, stock cover and next moves
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




  





 \- 3–6 years managing marketplace sales for a D2C or consumer brand, with direct revenue ownership
 



  





 \- A proven record of growing a brand on Amazon and/or Flipkart. Come with numbers: from what, to what, in how long.
 



  





 \- Existing relationships with platform category teams (strong plus).
 



  





 \- Hands\-on with Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and ad consoles. You've run campaigns yourself, not just reviewed agency reports.
 



  





 \- Strong in Excel: pivots, lookups, margin analysis.
 



  





 \- Clear grasp of marketplace economics: commissions, fulfillment fees, GST, returns cost and their effect on margin
 



  





 \- High ownership and speed. You chase a stuck payment or a suppressed listing without being asked
 



  





**HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS** 




  





**First 90 days:** 
 a full audit of every account, a growth plan with targets per platform, and at least one category\-manager\-backed promotion live.
 



  





**First 12 months:** 
 60\-70% growth in marketplace GMV at or above target margin, ROAS above 10%, and account health green on every platform.
 



  





**WHAT YOU GET** 
 \- Direct access to the founders and a seat in channel and budget decisions \- Besides Industry matching compensation a performance bonus tied to GMV and margin. The chance to build a channel from the ground up at a company aiming for ₹1,000 crore.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 
 Apply here with your CV. In your note, tell us about one marketplace account you grew, with before\-and\-after numbers. Applications without numbers won't be shortlisted.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 Our partners \- card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs \- are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision\-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.
   

  

 The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low\-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care.
 **There's no playbook.**
**The Job**
* Own a portfolio of live partnerships \- deepen them and grow what they generate.
* Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month, with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.
* Run longer\-term partnerships that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.
* Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.
* Build the commercial construct, not just the relationship.
* Drive go\-live across product, operations and legal to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.
* Own the numbers on every relationship you hold and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 0–2 years of experience. Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.
* Have no degree or institution filter \- we care about what you can do, not where you studied.
* Write exceptionally well. This is the highest\-weighted skill for this role.
* Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.
* Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.
* Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.
* Are patient, input\-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.
* Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.
* Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision\-makers.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 Senior Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
 


 P R O D U C T S E C U R I T Y · A N A P L A N
 
**Reports to:** 
 Senior Manager, Platform Security
   

**Working model:** 
 Gurugram (Hybrid)
 


 Why this role matters
 
 This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at Anaplan! In this role, you will be at the forefront of scaling security through automation and self\-service. You’ll be the driving force behind transforming security intent into enforced, self\-service controls across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines. Think dependency policy, secrets handling, least\-privilege access, and the guardrails that allow engineering teams to innovate rapidly without compromising security.
 



  
 



 When done right, this is some of the most high\-leverage work in our function. Every control you implement will run continuously for every team, seamlessly integrated into their workflows!
 


 Why Anaplan
 
 Anaplan is not just another SaaS application; it’s a powerful platform that performs highly dimensional, enterprise\-scale modeling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. Our technical landscape is rich and varied, featuring the legacy Hyperblock engine, the innovative Polaris engine, and an expanding suite of AI\-powered products like CoModeler for AI\-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational, analyst\-style planning support.
 



  
 



 With AI revolutionizing software development, we are embracing more generated code and autonomous changes, making the need for encoded, verifiable guardrails more critical than ever. Security is woven into the fabric of how our platform evolves, rather than treated as an afterthought. Join our small, dynamic team where your contributions to automation will set the gold standard!
 


 What you'll do
 * Automate across the pipeline: build security automation into CI/CD and the broader SDLC so that controls run as code.
* Leverage AI to scale security automation: harness AI and LLM\-assisted tools to speed up control development, triage, and remediation, extending automated coverage beyond what traditional scripts can achieve.
* Implement policy\-as\-code: encode guardrails for dependency and package policies, secrets, and configurations so they enforce themselves effortlessly.
* Build the controlled\-repository model: automate the restriction of external dependencies and provide safe, approved package paths for our engineers.
* Automate secrets management and detection: ensure mishandled or leaked secrets are automatically caught and managed without the need for manual sweeps.
* Reduce standing privilege: develop automation for least privilege and just\-in\-time access, making persistent access the exception rather than the rule.
* Tame scanner output: integrate detection into low\-noise, actionable workflows that feed remediation, preventing overwhelming flood of alerts.
* Automate attack\-surface hardening: drive the creation of hardened, golden images and enforce baselines through code.
* Make controls self\-service: default to providing engineers with a paved path wherever it’s safe to do so, rather than imposing unnecessary gates.


 What we're looking for
 * Strong automation and engineering skills, particularly in languages such as Python or Go, along with expertise in infrastructure\-as\-code and pipeline work.
* In\-depth knowledge of DevSecOps: CI/CD security and hands\-on experience with policy\-as\-code using tools like OPA, Conftest, or Kyverno.
* Foundational understanding of cloud\-native security, particularly in Kubernetes and at least one major cloud provider, along with knowledge of secrets management and identity basics.
* A builder's instinct: you create tools that engineers love because they simplify their work.
* Genuine care for developer experience, always striving to reduce friction rather than adding unnecessary barriers.
* The discernment to identify which controls are truly worth encoding and which can be set aside.


 Nice to have
 * Experience with supply\-chain security: understanding of provenance and signing, as well as software or model bills of materials.
* Familiarity with zero\-trust and least\-privilege automation, including just\-in\-time access.
* Experience working in a regulated, enterprise environment.
* Contributions to open\-source security tooling or relevant certifications.



  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan.  Anaplan does not:

 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

description:

* Ensure seamless orchestration of systems and data across multiple functions and partners to support real\-time visibility and decision\-making.
* Serve as the bridge between business teams and technical teams, enabling solutions that are technically robust, scalable, secure, reasonable in cost and deliver the intended value.
* Enable continuous improvement and adoption, ensuring that solutions are effectively utilized and continually enhanced to meet evolving business needs.
* Engage cross\-functional teams including Finance/Controls, Sales, R\&D, Engineering and other external supply chain partners to ensure seamless integration of IT capabilities with business processes.


**Responsibilities**
**Business Engagement \& Requirement Management**
* Act as the primary IT partner for Supply Chain teams across Planning, Manufacturing, Agro, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Customer Service.

* Gather, validate, and translate functional requirements into clear solution specifications.
* Ensure alignment of all initiatives with supply chain strategy and enterprise architecture.


**Solution Design \& Functional Leadership**

* Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions based on fit, scalability, cost, and integration needs.
* Set up and actively lead design workshops, process mapping sessions, and blueprint creation.
* Ensure data, process, and integration consistency across applications.


**Project \& Program Delivery**

* Drive cross\-functional teams to meet timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Conduct and coordinate for UAT (user acceptance test) cycles, ensuring scenarios reflect true operational needs.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.


**Stakeholder Communication \& Change Management**
* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and decisions needed.
* Prepare communication materials, training documentation, and user onboarding content.
* Foster a culture of digital adoption, helping users confidently leverage new tools and systems.


**Data \& Analytics Enablement**
* Support accurate and timely data flows across systems.
* Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver dashboards, KPIs, and predictive insights.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and integration integrity across supply chain applications.


**Value Delivery \& Performance Tracking**
* Track benefits realization of IT investments (cost savings, service improvements, automation benefits).

**Continuous Improvement \& Digital Optimization**
* Identify automation, simplification, and digitization opportunities across supply chain processes.
* Lead process improvement initiatives using analytics and automation.

**Governance, Compliance \& Risk Management**

**Vendor \& Partner Management**

**Qualifications**

title: Infra Managed Service Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data\-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HAM
   

  

 Execute the end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro\-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states\-for end\-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.
   

  

 Maintain alm\_asset and alm\_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost\-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.
   

  

 Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit\-trail documentation.
   

  

 Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept\-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.
   

  

 Perform scheduled and ad\-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.
   

  

 Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60\-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.
   

  

 Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model\-category data per defined policy.
   

  

 CMDB
   

  

 Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.
   

  

 Apply and tune Identification \& Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules\-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules\-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate\-CI and overloaded\-CI exceptions.
   

  

 Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.
   

  

 Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.
   

  

 Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5\.0\)\-Foundation, Ideation \& Strategy, Design \& Planning, Build \& Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.
   

  

 Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 3\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.
   

  

 Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.
   

  

 Hands\-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate\-CI deduplication exercise.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.
   

  

 ITIL v4 process awareness\-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.
   

  

 Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.
   

  

 Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.
   

  

 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

 ServiceNow Modules
   

  

 HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).
   

  

 Educational Qualification:
   

  

 15 years of full\-time education
   

  

 Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

title: Brand Operator
description:
Position: Brand Operator
   

  

 Location: Gurgaon
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience Required: 2\-5 years
   

  

 Brand Operator
   

  

**About Our Client**
 Our Client is an exciting
 **better\-for\-you South Indian snacking brand** 
 backed by strong investors and funding, with an ambition to build a differentiated, category\-defining consumer business.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Brand Operator** 
 who can work closely with the founding team to build, scale and strengthen the brand across consumer, growth and go\-to\-market.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys moving beyond strategy decks and actually
 **building things, testing ideas, solving problems and driving outcomes.**
 The Role
   

  

 As a Brand Operator, you will sit at the intersection of
 **Brand, Consumer, Growth and GTM** 
 .
   

  

 You will be expected to understand the consumer deeply, identify opportunities for growth, translate insights into action, and work cross\-functionally to take initiatives from
 **idea → execution → measurable business impact** 
 .
   

  

 This is not a traditional Brand Manager role. We are looking for someone who thinks like an
 **operator** 
 — someone who can take ownership, make decisions, execute with speed and continuously figure out what will move the business forward.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

* Build and strengthen Our Client's brand positioning, consumer proposition and overall brand narrative.
* Develop a deep understanding of the target consumer, category, competition and emerging consumption trends.
* Drive go\-to\-market strategy and execution for new products, campaigns, channels and consumer initiatives.
* Identify and execute growth opportunities across D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce and other relevant channels.
* Work closely with creative, performance, product, sales, distribution and external partners to translate strategy into execution.
* Use consumer and business data to evaluate what is working and make informed decisions on products, campaigns, channels and growth initiatives.
* Track key business metrics including acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue, AOV and channel performance.
* Experiment rapidly, learn from outcomes and scale initiatives that demonstrate traction.
* Help build the processes, systems and operating rhythm required to scale a consumer brand at an early stage.
* Work closely with the founding/investment team and take end\-to\-end ownership of high\-priority business initiatives.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\-6 years of overall professional experience.
* 2\-3\+ years of experience in D2C consumer brands, preferably in Food \& Beverage.
* Hands\-on experience across Brand, Growth or GTM, with ownership of initiatives that have contributed to measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, brand building, go\-to\-market and growth.
* Strong commercial and analytical orientation with an ability to connect consumer initiatives to business metrics.
* Demonstrated experience of taking a product, brand or initiative from launch/early stage through execution and scale.
* Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment where you are expected to figure things out rather than wait for a playbook.
* Strong cross\-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Tier 1 MBA preferred.
* Proficiency in at least one South Indian language is preferred.


 The Ideal Candidate
   

  

 You could be a strong fit if you are someone who:
   

  

**Thinks like a brand builder, operates like a generalist and measures success like a business owner.**
 You don't just ask
 *“How do we market this?”* 
 — you ask:
   

  

**Who is this for? Why will they care? What should we build? How should we launch it? Where should we sell it? What is working? And how do we scale it?**
 Why This Role
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work on a consumer brand
 **from the ground up** 
 , with significant ownership and direct exposure to the decisions that shape the business.
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to influence
 **what the brand stands for, how it goes to market, how consumers discover and experience it, and ultimately how it scales.**

title: PR & Communications Manager
description:
**About Us :** 
  





 Established in 1996, Morphogenesis is globally recognized for its diverse work, encompassing a range of specialized practice areas such as Master Planning, Urban Design, Architecture, Interior Design, and Landscape Design. Our belief in sustainability shapes all our work, forming the consistent theme in our designs.
   





 Morphogenesis sees itself as an institution in perpetuity – a living, thriving ecosystem, a repository of data, information, knowledge, and wisdom. ‘Learning’ is the firm’s strongest value, and each Morphogenesis member learns and contributes to learning in equal measure. The firm enables this by building out its program along the lines of an educational course and offers wide exposure, both in terms of projects and discourse. Furthermore, the conscious choice to operate in a mini studio format allows for cross\-pollination of ideas and propagates high levels of design innovation.
   

  





 The
 **PR \& Communications Manager** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing the firm’s communications strategy to enhance its visibility, reputation, and influence within the architecture and design industry. This role combines strategic oversight with hands\-on execution — managing media relations, award submissions, publications, and storytelling initiatives that reflect the firm’s design ethos and creative vision.
   





 The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of architecture and design culture, a network of media relationships within the field, and the ability to translate complex design concepts into compelling narratives for both professional and public audiences.
   

  

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

  

 Strategic Communications \& Brand Positioning
   

  

  

* Develop and implement the firm’s comprehensive PR and communications strategy in alignment with its brand identity and business objectives.
* Define and maintain key messaging, tone of voice, and visual language consistency across all communication channels.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to elevate the firm’s profile through media exposure, industry recognition, and thought leadership initiatives.


 Media Relations \& Press Coordination
   

  

  

* Build and sustain strong relationships with editors, journalists, and media partners in architecture, design, and lifestyle sectors.
* Oversee the creation and distribution of press releases, media kits, and editorial content that accurately represent the firm’s projects and philosophy.
* Coordinate interviews, feature stories, and speaking engagements for firm leadership.
* Maintain and expand the firm’s media database and track coverage across print and digital platforms.


 Awards, Publications \& Industry Recognition
   

  

  

* Develop and manage the firm’s annual awards calendar — identifying relevant opportunities, preparing high\-quality submissions, and tracking outcomes.
* Research and maintain knowledge of emerging award programs and media platforms relevant to architecture and design.
* Oversee relationships with design publications to secure coverage, guest features, and collaboration opportunities.


 Content Development \& Storytelling
   

  

  

* Collaborate with design teams to craft accurate, engaging project narratives, case studies, and firm profiles for publication and presentations.
* Ensure all public\-facing content (press materials, website updates, brochures, social posts) aligns with the firm’s brand standards.
* Support the preparation of communication materials for events, exhibitions, and speaking engagements.


 Internal Communication \& Coordination
   

  

  

* Act as a liaison between design, marketing, and leadership teams to ensure consistency and accuracy of information shared externally.
* Manage information flow for new project announcements, press approvals, and award submissions.
* Coordinate with external PR agencies, photographers, and consultants when required.


 Monitoring \& Reporting
   

  

  

* Track and analyze media coverage, maintaining an organized press archive and performance reports.
* Provide insights on communications performance, visibility trends, and competitor positioning to inform future strategy.



  





  

  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  

  

 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Architecture, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in PR and communications, ideally within the architecture, design, or creative industries.
* Proven success in developing and executing PR strategies and securing media coverage across design and architecture publications.
* Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and familiarity with PR tools and databases.
* A genuine passion for architecture, design culture, and the built environment.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

  

* Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail and executional follow\-through.
* Confident communicator with a collaborative approach and ability to engage effectively with designers, partners, and media professionals.
* Creative, proactive, and resourceful in identifying new opportunities for exposure and engagement.
* Enthusiastic about storytelling that celebrates design excellence and innovation.

title: Paid Media Implementation & Optimisation Executive
description:
**Location \-**

 \- 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in ad accounts (agency, edtech or institute)
 



  





**Purpose** 




 Turn the approved media plan into live, correctly tracked campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn and ChatGPT Ads, and optimise them weekly to cost per net registration — not to clicks or leads. 
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Build and run campaigns from the media plan: Google Search, AI Max, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube and RLSA; Meta Advantage\+ Leads, click\-to\-WhatsApp and lead forms; LinkedIn Sponsored Content and Lead Gen Forms for FIIB's various offerings, ChatGPT Ads and Bing imports. Pace spend to plan (±10%) by programme and campaign; flag under\- and over\-delivery weekly.
* Own audiences: remarketing lists, Customer Match/custom audiences from hashed CRM exports, exclusion lists for registered students, lookalikes; keep them refreshed every cycle stage.
* Define conversion actions with the Ops Executive: enhanced conversions, Meta CAPI events, offline conversion import of net registrations from the CRM, so every platform optimises to the right signal.
* Run a monthly competitor sweep on Google Ads Transparency Centre, Meta Ad Library and LinkedIn Ad Library and turn it into creative and offer tests.
* Brief landing\-page and creative changes to the web design team; run structured A/B tests on headline, proof and CTA.
* Deliver a Monday report: spend, CPC, cost per paid form, form\-to\-registration %, cost per net registration by programme, with three actions for the week.
* Track platform changes and publish a one\-page “what changed, what we do about it” note monthly.



  





**Must have** 



* Has personally managed ≥ ₹2\-3L/Month across Google, Meta and LinkedIn with conversion tracking they set up or audited themselves; can explain AI Max, Advantage\+ and CAPI in plain words.
* Comfortable with Google Ads Editor, bulk sheets, UTM discipline, hashed list uploads and audience rules.
* Reads GA4 and Search Console well enough to challenge platform\-reported numbers.
* High attention to detail: one wrong exclusion or budget cap in January costs real registrations.



  





**Good to have** 
  
 



 Google Ads Search \+ Measurement and Meta Media Buying certifications; LinkedIn Campaign Manager; edu\-portal or higher\-education admissions experience; basic Canva / creative iteration; Hindi\-English ad copy sense. 
 



  





**Success in 12 months** 




**Cost per net registration (paid) \-** 
 At or below the media\-plan model (≈ ₹29K benchmark), reported weekly 
 



**Paid form → net registration \-** 
 ≥ 20%, tracked by campaign 
 



**Budget pacing \-** 
 Within ±10% of plan every month; zero unplanned overspend 
 



**Tracking hygiene \-** 
 100% of paid traffic UTM\-tagged; blank “Source Campaign” for paid leads \< 10%

This is a good fit for a recent design graduate who wants to work across many brands at once, and who enjoys both creative thinking and keeping things in order.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Manage daily client communication across WhatsApp, email and calls, with timely and thoughtful replies.
* Share content calendars and creatives with clients, gather their feedback and get sign\-offs on time.
* Turn client feedback into clear, actionable briefs for the design and content team.
* Art direct shoots remotely, liaising with photography and videography teams across the country, briefing them on look and feel, and keeping the output in line with the creative direction set with the founder.
* Brainstorm content ideas, post concepts and campaign angles with clients, and bring fresh suggestions to review calls. Ideas that shape larger campaigns or brand direction are developed together with the founder.
* Log new requirements, check them against the agreed scope and flag anything that falls outside it.
* Schedule meetings between the founder and clients for new projects, set a clear agenda beforehand, and share any background the founder needs to walk in prepared.
* Follow up after meetings with a summary of decisions, next steps and timelines for both the client and the internal team.
* Send weekly status updates to each client covering progress, pending items and inputs needed.
* Join and coordinate routine review calls, and share notes and next steps afterward.
* Track deadlines across accounts and raise risks early.
* Use good judgement on what to handle independently and what genuinely needs the founder's input.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* A recent graduate from NIFT, Pearl Academy, NID, Srishti or a comparable design school in India or abroad. Internship experience at a studio, agency or brand is a plus.
* A polite, kind and patient nature. Clients should come away from every interaction feeling heard and cared for.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, clear and professional tone.
* A curious, creative mind and genuine interest in content, trends and brand storytelling, so you can contribute ideas with confidence.
* A strong eye for aesthetics, so you can judge whether a creative is ready to go to a client and whether a shoot is on brief.
* Strong organisation and follow\-up habits. Nothing slips through the cracks with you.
* The confidence to push back politely and hold the line on scope and timelines.
* Comfort working independently and staying responsive during working hours.
* Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, Notion or Trello, and Instagram.
* A dual SIM smartphone, so a dedicated See And Say work number can be used for client communication, along with a laptop and a stable internet connection.



  





**Why join us** 



* You'll work closely with the founder and learn how brand strategy is built from the ground up.
* You'll work on a portfolio of thoughtful, design\-led brands across home, lifestyle, beauty and wellness.
* You'll get real creative responsibility early, including art directing shoots.
* There's room to grow into a senior client or strategy role as the consultancy expands.



  





 This is a work\-from\-home role. We use desktop monitoring software during working hours to keep collaboration smooth across the team.
 



  





**To apply** 



* **Email your CV and portfolio link to reach@studioseeandsay.com**

title: Associate: Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
description:
**About the Organisation** 




 Collective Good Foundation (CGF) (https://collectivegood.in/about\-us/) is dedicated to developing ecosystems that facilitate sustainable impact. It provides comprehensive program design and implementation solutions to companies and social organisations to address issues across cause areas; enhancing capacities in the development sector and building interventions that can be scaled.
 **Collective Good Foundation currently houses ‘Samyak’, a health initiative set up by a team of professionals with extensive experience in the public health sector in India** 
 .
 



  





 Samyak started off by setting up a pan India, multi\-stakeholder collaborative (Urban Health Initiative (UHI)) 2 years back, to address urban health and nutrition challenges with a focus on urban poor and marginalized populations. UHI brings together urban practitioners, public health experts, donor agencies, government stakeholders and non\-profit organisations to strengthen the urban health system in India, improving the quality of life of people and reducing existing health inequities. Priority areas of UHI includes, among other things, emerging health challenges due to climate change; wherein the Urban Health Initiative is working, under an MoU with the Govt of Uttar Pradesh to address data gaps around climate – health linkages, as well as piloting innovative models to address some of these challenges. UHI is also working in Maharashtra. Partners of Samyak include Janaagraha Centre for Citizenship and Democracy, Samhita, J\-PAL Climate – Health Data Capacity Accelerator, ARTPARK, India Health Fund and ACT for Health.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 CGF is seeking a Data Manager to support the development and management of data systems for Samyak’s urban health initiatives in Maharashtra.
 



 The Data Manager will play a key role in integrating multiple health datasets, developing dashboards, applying advanced analytics, and supporting AI\-enabled data analysis to generate actionable insights for program teams and government stakeholders.
 



 The role requires strong analytical and technical skills, experience working with large health datasets, and the ability to translate complex data into clear visualizations and decision\-support tools.
 



 The position is based in Mumbai and will involve collaboration with program teams, government partners, research teams, and technology partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Data Systems and Management** 



* Manage and maintain data systems supporting urban health programs and decision support platforms.
* Integrate multiple data sources
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across integrated data systems.



**Data Analysis and Insights** 



* Analyze large and complex health datasets to generate actionable insights for program planning and policy decision making.
* Identify trends, patterns, and gaps in urban health service delivery and health outcomes.
* Support the development of analytical outputs for research studies, program reviews, and policy discussions.



**Dashboard Development and Data Visualization** 



* Design and develop interactive dashboards and data visualization tools for program teams and government stakeholders.
* Build dashboards that support real\-time monitoring, performance tracking, and decision support.
* Ensure dashboards present data in clear, intuitive, and user\-friendly formats.



**AI\-enabled Data Analytics** 



* Explore and apply AI and machine learning tools to create data collection tools, support data analysis, predictive insights, and pattern detection.
* Use AI\-enabled tools to enhance data processing, analytics, and visualization workflows.
* Support the development of data\-driven decision support systems for urban health programs.



**Data Integration and Interoperability, and data governance** 



* Support the integration of datasets from multiple platforms and sources.
* Develop processes for data cleaning, transformation, and harmonization.
* Work with technology partners to ensure interoperability between data systems and analytics platforms.



**Program and Stakeholder Support** 



* Provide analytical support to program teams, research teams, and government stakeholders.
* Support preparation of data summaries, analytical briefs, and visualizations for presentations and reports.
* Build the capacity of program teams to interpret and use data for decision making.



 Qualifications and Experience
 


* Postgraduate degree in Data Science, Public Health, Statistics, Epidemiology, Computer Science, or related fields.
* 3\-6 years of experience in data management, analytics, or data science roles.
* Experience working with health data systems, public health programs, or development sector datasets is preferred.
* Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources. Strong analytical and statistical skills. Experience with data analysis tools, such as Python, R, Advanced Excel
* Experience developing dashboards using tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning tools for data analysis would be an advantage.



**Language Requirement** 



* Proficiency in Marathi (reading, writing, and speaking) is needed

**About The Role**
 Our purpose is to use the power of communication to make a better world. For each other, for our customers, for society and our communities.
   

  

 The team provides 2nd line diagnostic support and managed services to our customers through the use of routing, switching, wireless technologies and products, 24x7x365 days a year. By using market leading products and applying BTs process, quality and intellectual property, we provide our customers with services to facilitate their objectives through the power of communication.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Act as the frontline operational contact for network\-related incidents, service requests, and operational activities.
   

  

 Provide 2nd Line support for BT Enterprise networking services, ensuring delivery within agreed SLAs.
   

  

 Own and resolve complex incidents, service requests, problems and escalations.
   

  

 Perform troubleshooting, fault diagnosis and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across customer environments.
   

  

 Manage tickets and customer communications through SNOW, NGSD and associated systems.
   

  

 Execute technical changes, impact assessments, risk reviews and peer reviews in line with BT change governance.
   

  

 Collaborate with customers, vendors and internal teams to drive service restoration and issue resolution.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation, RCA reports and customer updates.
   

  

 Support software upgrades, patching and platform maintenance activities.
   

  

 Drive continuous improvement, process standardisation and operational excellence.
   

  

 Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and contribute to team capability development.
   

  

**Essential Skills / Experience**
 CCNA certification is good to have.
   

  

 Experience supporting LAN, WAN, Wireless and SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

 Basic knowledge of Cisco, Meraki, TCP/IP, Routing Protocols and QoS.
   

  

 Experience with ServiceNow (SNOW), NGSD and ITSM ticketing tools.
   

  

 Strong knowledge into AI along with Python and Ansible.
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Strong customer, stakeholder and communication skills.
   

  

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
 CCNA Certification
   

  

 SDWAN Knowledge
   

  

 ServiceNow tool/ SNOW
   

  

 BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
   

  

 BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
   

  

 Having come through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
   

  

 We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer\-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**Company Description** 
 Northlane AI is a technology\-driven company focused on using artificial intelligence to help organizations improve their marketing performance and decision\-making. The team combines data science, machine learning, and digital marketing expertise to create solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Northlane AI values curiosity, experimentation, and collaboration, encouraging team members to explore new approaches and tools. The company supports remote work and invests in modern workflows to enable flexible, efficient collaboration across distributed teams.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time remote Google Ads Specialist role is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing Google Ads campaigns across search, display, video, and other relevant networks. Day\-to\-day tasks include conducting keyword research, building and refining campaign structures, writing and testing ad copy, and setting up audience targeting and bid strategies. The specialist will monitor performance metrics, analyze data, and implement optimizations to improve click\-through rates, conversion rates, and return on ad spend. The role also involves collaborating with marketing, product, and analytics teams to align campaigns with business goals, manage budgets, prepare performance reports, and stay current with Google Ads best practices and policy updates.

* Proficiency in performance analysis using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards.
* Experience with digital marketing strategy, including landing page optimization, conversion rate optimization, and funnel analysis.
* Ability to create and test effective ad copy and creatives tailored to different formats (search, display, video).
* Comfort working with data, including interpreting metrics, running A/B tests, and making data\-informed decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross\-functional remote teams.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with AI\-driven or automated bidding tools and marketing platforms is a plus.
* Prior experience managing Google Ads in B2B or SaaS environments is beneficial.

title: Head of Talent
description:
**What This Role Is** 




  





 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
 



  





 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
 



  





 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You translate talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
 



 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation Manifest expects every function to become, and proving Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different** 




  





 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is an advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
 



  





 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
 



  





**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade** 




  





 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that talent leadership can earn a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like.
 



  





**What You Own** 




**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine** 



* Own hiring strategy and standard across every brand, geography, and level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold the function accountable to it



**Talent Operations and the Employee Experience** 



* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the rigor a business its size requires



  





**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession** 



* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness
* Set the standard for a high\-performing team at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes it repeatable



**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment** 



* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable as revenue



**Talent AI and Infrastructure** 



* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products



**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership** 



* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people
* Equity participation is part of the package for a role at this altitude.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
 



  





 In the first months, you have formed a clear point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, where the leadership bench needs building, and what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath it all needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and the executive team.
 



  





 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible as finance's.
 



  





 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
 



  





 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




  





 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as interconnected systems and bets, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
 



  





 You have built high\-performing teams before, and know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and one that performs because the systems and standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
 



  





 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and know the difference between AI bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
 



  





 You have a real point of view on talent and are comfortable carrying it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic.
 



  





 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
 



  





**Why Manifest** 




  





 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.
 



 For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.
 



  





 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

title: Executive Vice President, Evidence
description:
**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research, including from Nobel\-winning economists. We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we are making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Deworm the World has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains
* Safe Water Now has saved the lives of over 15,000 children
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You will partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you are looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 Evidence Action was built on the belief that data should drive every decision, from how programs are designed and delivered to how resources are allocated and scaled. Evidence and cost\-effectiveness are central to Evidence Action's comparative advantage; they are what makes us credible and distinctive to government partners and donors alike, and this role will shape how that advantage evolves as we grow.
   

  

 As the Executive Vice President (EVP), Evidence, you will own the strategic growth and transformation of our Monitoring, Learning, and Evaluation teams, our Cost\-Effectiveness arm, and our epidemiology capability at a pivotal organizational moment. You will sit at the intersection of technical rigor, organizational leadership, and external credibility, holding overall accountability for the reliability of the evidence that guides how Evidence Action designs, delivers, and scales its programs. Our recent Dispensers for Safe Water update reflects the transparent, evidence\-first culture this role will help lead.
   

  

 This is a role with two connected mandates under one leader. You will lead the generation and use of evidence throughout the program lifecycle in close collaboration with programs, while maintaining an independence in your assessment of evidence, surfacing uncomfortable findings when necessary. Bringing these together in one senior role reporting directly to the CEO gives evidence a genuine, empowered voice in our decision\-making.
   

  

 In this role, you will sit on Evidence Action's Global Leadership Team (GLT), which sets organizational strategy and direction. This is a pivotal opportunity for an executive who can navigate complexity, inspire high\-performing teams, and translate evidence into action, driving measurable improvements in millions of lives for years to come.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
**Lead a holistic evidence function**
* Oversee the technical and strategic aspects of our evidence teams, ensuring MLE, cost\-effectiveness modeling, and epidemiology connect into a single, coherent picture that informs day\-to\-day program improvement and major decisions, rather than separate streams of analysis
* In collaboration with GLT and program leads, set a cross\-program evidence strategy, defining the questions Evidence Action is answering across its portfolio, matching the right methodological approaches and connecting evidence to both delivery and organizational learning
* Serve as a technical thought partner to teams across Evidence Action, making evidence more readily visible and actionable across the organization, evolving our cost\-effectiveness tooling to enhance visibility into what drives cost\-effectiveness and shortening the feedback loop between realized costs and impact and our projected impact.
* Champion evidence across a program's lifecycle, ensuring we're designing the right evidence generation to feed lessons into scaling decisions and evolving our cost\-effectiveness tools so organizational leaders understand what drives cost\-effectiveness and we can actualize modeled impact
* Institutionalize monitoring and learning (e.g. A/B testing) in programs so performance keeps improving well beyond launch
* Sharpen where Evidence Action's own evidence generation is uniquely valuable versus where other partners are better placed


**Own independent quality assurance**
* Understand how different evidence sources come together across programs to model our impact, and establish and enforce minimum standards for addressing weak evidence, uncertainty, and assumptions in that modeling
* Design and implement the systems that let us review evidence consistently across our portfolio, including program stage gates and structured evidence and programmatic reviews at key decision points
* Own data quality assurance so it is structurally independent from evidence generation, setting methodology standards, commissioning re\-surveys and integrity checks, and surfacing issues early and transparently
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations that inform program scale\-up, ongoing iteration, and wind\-down decisions, holding a strong voice in those decisions while partnering with program and regional leaders who bring essential local context


**Strengthen technical capability and relieve program teams**
* Build internal technical management capacity that benefit our programs
* Lead a multi\-disciplinary function through consolidation and change, building trust across MLE, cost\-effectiveness, and epidemiology teams and bringing our people along through a significant transition
* Identify where AI and modern data tools can strengthen evidence generation and decision\-making at scale


**Represent Evidence Action externally**
* Serve as a senior organizational voice on evidence, engaging donors, the board, and technical partners on our evidence philosophy, methodological choices, and standing evaluation arrangements
* Champion a transparent culture that shares learning; including learning from what does not work, both inside the organization and with the relevant external stakeholders


**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a leader with rigorous technical training who has spent much of their career as a user and steward of evidence in real implementation settings, not primarily as an academic researcher.
   

  

**Essential**
* The courage to act on evidence. You are willing to surface uncomfortable findings to senior leadership and to recommend a change of course when the evidence calls for it
* Technical leadership and management at scale. You have led similar technical teams, upholding quality assurance, in low\- and middle\-income country contexts with a grounding in operational rigor
* Program\-implementation grounding. You pair academic research expertise with genuine operational experience, so you lead as an insider rather than from a distance.
* Technical credibility and range. A PhD or equivalent quantitative expertise that lets you judge the quality of evidence produced, hold teams to a high technical bar, draw on a range of analytical methods, and speak with authority alongside senior technical staff and external partners. Must have a background in cost\-effectiveness or health economics, or the judgment to bring in the right experts
* A strong leader of teams and change. You can conceptualize change management and bring people along, delegate across a large scope, and build trust across teams and cultures


**What this role is not**
* This is not an audit or compliance role. This role is intended to build the systems and structures that reinforce the appropriate generation and application of evidence as programs evolve, so evidence becomes more than just a box we check
* This is not a publication engine. External research is not the primary goal of this work
* This is not a remote or distant role. Field presence and proximity to implementation are design requirements


**Location**
 This role location is flexible, though we have a preference for a country where Evidence Action has an office, with India, Kenya, and Nigeria of particular interest.
   

  

 This role will require approximately 20% travel nationally and internationally as needed.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide.
   

  

* Benefits may differ based on country\-specific regulations


 Benefits include:
   

  

 Comprehensive health insurance
   

  

 Pension/ Retirement savings options
   

  

 Paid leave
   

  

 Avenues for engagement and recognition.
   

  

 Compensation is competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and internal pay scale.
   

  

 Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to representation and inclusion. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
