**What Success Looks Like**
* You’re a strategic advisor to clients and internal teams, driving measurable impact and platform maturity.
* You create repeatable frameworks and tools that improve team efficiency and customer outcomes.
* You proactively elevate the implementation practice by sharing knowledge, defining standards, and fostering innovation.
* You maintain a customer\-first mindset, consistently exceeding expectations in high\-pressure environments.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

title: Manage - Transformation & Operations
description:
**Manager, Transformation \& Operations** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 10\-15 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management, and interim leadership services to companies, investors, and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented solutions that help organizations tackle complex issues, improve operating performance, create value, and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations solve complex business issues and maximize stakeholder value. A\&M’s culture is grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with founding principles of Leadership, Action, and Results. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Manager, Transformation \& Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A\&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services \& Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business\-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands\-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people\-management position or a client\-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
* Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
* Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
* Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
* Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
* Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
* Mentor junior team members in consulting\-style problem\-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
* Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations roles.
* Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS operating models, shared services best practices, transition planning, process improvement, process documentation, and execution\-level change management.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex workstreams from planning through delivery, with the ability to manage risks, dependencies, deliverable quality, and multiple moving pieces independently.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, including cost, volume, efficiency, financial modelling, business\-case development, and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear documentation, training materials, leadership updates, and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and present findings effectively to functional leaders and operations teams.
* Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance, with prior consulting firm experience and knowledge of India GCC or multinational shared services environments preferred.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering GCC/GBS transformation engagements, shared services implementations, or operating model transitions across multiple corporate functions.
* Prior experience in a Big Four firm, boutique consulting firm, consulting practice, or a comparable transformation\-focused operations environment.
* Exposure to building reusable playbooks, process libraries, training programs, and capability\-development mechanisms for growing operations teams.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring 10–15 years of professional experience, including 10 or more years in GCC/GBS transformation, operations consulting, shared services, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations. Your experience shows sustained ownership of complex execution rather than strategy recommendations alone.
* You bring hands\-on capability in workstream management, transition planning, process improvement, documentation, and change execution. You can turn broad priorities into detailed plans, control risks, maintain quality, and deliver outcomes with limited supervision.
* You bring strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to assess costs, volumes, efficiency, ROI, and operating trade\-offs. You can build credible financial models and business cases that help leaders prioritize investments and improvements.
* You bring a Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance and communicate with clarity across senior leaders, functional teams, regional partners, and operations colleagues. You influence without authority, manage detail, mentor others, and remain effective in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Alvarez \& Marsal, you will join a global professional services firm where practical execution, independent thinking, and measurable results shape the work. This role offers the opportunity to help build and strengthen a rapidly growing Global Capability Center in India while working directly with local and global leadership. You will have visibility into strategic decision\-making and direct ownership of transformation workstreams that influence how corporate functions operate and scale. The small central operations team provides meaningful responsibility, close collaboration, and room to expand your scope as the GCC and its capabilities grow. You will work across functions, geographies, and industries while building expertise in transitions, operating models, process improvement, and business performance. A\&M supports professional growth through mentorship, formal training, A\&M University, on\-the\-job learning, internal mobility, and performance development. The culture values integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal contribution, while encouraging people to bring an entrepreneurial, action\-oriented approach to complex problems.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to local and global leadership, meaningful ownership of transformation workstreams, and the opportunity to influence operating practices within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.
* A development environment combining formal training, A\&M University, mentorship, on\-the\-job learning, performance development, and internal mobility for continued professional growth.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, wellness resources, work\-life balance support, employee resource groups, flexible work models, and opportunities to contribute to community programs.

title: Meller India Head
description:
**Mission Brief: Build and Scale Meller as a Business in India** 




  





 Meller, Lenskart's Barcelona\-born, D2C\-first sunglasses brand is entering its next chapter in India. Known for bold silhouettes, expressive colourways, and a design language rooted in Barcelona's street culture, Meller has a cult following of 700K\+ on Instagram and a strong Gen Z and Millennial fan base across Europe and the U.S.
 



  





 This role owns Meller as a business in India end\-to\-end P\&L, growth strategy, and operational execution across retail, e\-commerce, and marketing. Sitting at Lenskart's India HQ, you will effectively run Meller India as a founder would: setting the strategy, building the team, and making the commercial, brand, and operational calls that turn Meller to a category\-leading sunglasses brand in India.
 



  





 This is a builder's role at the intersection of business leadership, brand, and retail. You'll work closely with the global Meller team in Barcelona, Lenskart's leadership, and internal functions spanning category, retail, e\-commerce, supply chain, and finance while building a lean India team to execute the mission.
 



  





**🔑 Core Mandate: Business Ownership \& P\&L Leadership** 




  





**1\. Business Strategy \& P\&L Ownership (The Founder Focus)** 




**P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own Meller India's P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, margin, and profitability — making the trade\-offs needed to build a healthy, scaling business.
 



**Business Strategy:** 
 Define and drive Meller's India growth strategy — market entry sequencing, channel mix, pricing, and expansion roadmap across retail and online.
 



**Brand Architecture Fit:** 
 Position Meller within Lenskart's house\-of\-brands portfolio (alongside John Jacobs, Owndays, and Le Petit Lunetier), with clear differentiation in price, design, and audience.
 



**Investment \& Resource Allocation:** 
 Decide where to invest — stores, marketing, people, technology — to maximise growth and return, and build the business case for future investment.
 



  





**2\. Retail, Category \& Channel Execution (The Growth Focus)** 




**Retail Rollout \& Performance:** 
 Own store performance and expansion across the \~500 launch stores and beyond — driving sell\-through, productivity, and the store economics that justify further rollout.
 



**Category \& Assortment Strategy:** 
 Partner with category and buying teams to shape the assortment strategy, ensuring product\-market fit for Indian consumers while staying true to Meller's global design DNA.
 



**E\-commerce \& D2C Growth:** 
 Drive Meller's presence and growth across Lenskart's app, website, and D2C channels, balancing brand experience with commercial performance.
 



**Channel \& Partnership Development:** 
 Identify and build new channels and partnerships — marketplaces, collaborations, wholesale, or others — that extend Meller's reach in India.
 



  





**3\. Brand, Marketing \& Consumer Experience** 




**Brand Custodianship:** 
 Ensure Meller's brand voice, positioning, and consumer experience in India stay true to its bold, design\-led, youth\-first DNA within global brand guidelines.
 



**Marketing Strategy Oversight:** 
 Set the direction for Meller's marketing engine in India — brand campaigns, influencer and community building, and performance marketing — and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
 



**Consumer Insight:** 
 Build a strong read on the Indian Gen Z and Millennial consumer — fashion trends, buying behaviour, and sentiment — to keep Meller's proposition sharp.
 



  





**4\. Global Coordination, Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 




**Global Coordination:** 
 Serve as the primary interface between the Barcelona\-based Meller team and Lenskart's India leadership — aligning on strategy, brand consistency, and market learnings.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Work closely with Retail, E\-commerce, Category, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure the business runs as one integrated system.
 



**Team Building:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a lean, high\-performing India team capable of running Meller as an independent, founder\-led business within Lenskart.
 



**Leadership Reporting:** 
 Own business reviews and reporting cadences with Lenskart and Meller global leadership — covering performance, strategy, and course corrections.
 



  





**The Essentials** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 Proven experience in business leadership, general management, or P\&L ownership roles, with meaningful experience building or scaling a D2C brand; exposure to fashion/lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands is a strong plus, as is an entrepreneurial bent of mind.
* **P\&L \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Proven ability to own and grow a P\&L — balancing revenue growth, margin, and working capital while making sound commercial trade\-offs.
* **Brand \& Retail Understanding:** 
 Strong grounding in brand building, retail operations, and consumer behaviour, particularly within fashion, lifestyle, or eyewear categories.
* **Entrepreneurial Track Record:** 
 Experience building or scaling a business, brand, or new market with founder\-like ownership, ideally in a fast\-growing or category\-disrupting environment.
* **Cross\-Border Collaboration:** 
 Experience or strong aptitude for working with global teams, balancing brand consistency with local market relevance.
* **Stakeholder \& Team Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence senior leaders across commercial, retail, marketing, and finance functions.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.



  





**🧠 The Mindset** 




  




* **Founder's Mentality:** 
 You think and act like you own the business — chasing outcomes, not just tasks, and taking full accountability for Meller's success in India.
* **Brand Storyteller:** 
 You understand how to turn a brand's design DNA into stories and experiences that resonate with a new generation of consumers.
* **Globally Minded, Locally Grounded:** 
 You carry a brand's global identity faithfully while adapting it with nuance for Indian consumers and platforms.
* **Commercially Grounded:** 
 You balance brand ambition with the discipline of running a healthy, profitable business.
* **Entrepreneurial Bent of Mind:** 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity, quick to take ownership, resourceful with limited support, and driven to make things happen rather than wait for a playbook.
* **Collaborative Operator** 
 : You move easily between strategic, creative, and commercial conversations, working across category, retail, and global brand teams to get things done.
* **Execution\-Focused:** 
 You don't just set strategy — you see it through, chase details, and hold the bar high at every touchpoint.

title: Senior Manager - WFM
description:
**Job Description:**
**Position Summary**
 Client\-facing WFM leader accountable for forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real\-time management, reporting, and workforce governance across complex operations. Partners with Service Delivery, Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, and clients to convert demand forecasts into hiring plans, staffing models, and scalable workforce strategies. Builds a high\-performing, data\-driven WFM function that improves forecast accuracy, schedule effectiveness, operational efficiency, and client confidence.
   

  

**Key WFM Skills Summary**
* Client\-facing insights, executive communication, escalation management, and stakeholder partnership
* Forecasting, capacity planning, staffing models, and headcount strategy
* Schedule optimization, real\-time management, queue monitoring, and SLA performance
* WFM reporting, forecast accuracy, adherence, occupancy, utilization, shrinkage, and attrition analytics
* WFM tools, dashboard automation, governance, process standardization, and team leadership


**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead workforce forecasting, capacity planning, and headcount strategy
* Serve as escalation point for workforce\-related risks, issues, and client\-impacting challenges.
* Develop short\- and long\-term volume forecasts using trends, business inputs, and predictive models.
* Translate forecasts into hiring plans, staffing models, and capacity recommendations.
* Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition on ramp plans, site expansions, onboarding, and workforce readiness.
* Manage planning assumptions for shrinkage, attrition, leave, training, absenteeism, and ramp productivity.
* Monitor queues, staffing, adherence, and service performance; drive intraday actions as needed.
* Provide scenario modeling and recommendations to support service levels, budget, and resource optimization.
* Refresh workforce plans using current performance data, client demand signals, and business inputs.
* Own scheduling, real\-time management, and operational performance
* Optimize schedules to meet SLAs, occupancy, utilization, productivity, and client service targets.
* Allocate resources across shifts, queues, workstreams, and locations, including 24/7 operations where applicable. WFM reporting, tools, governance, and continuous improvement
* Own WFM reporting for service levels, occupancy, utilization, forecast accuracy, adherence, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity.
* Deliver insights that improve efficiency, cost management, workforce utilization, and client outcomes.
* Ensure accurate workforce data across WFM tools, dashboards, and operational systems.
* Optimize WFM tools, automation, governance, scheduling standards, and reporting processes.


**Qualifications**
* Strong client\-facing presence; able to present WFM insights, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
* Experience leading WFM functions across forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real\-time management, reporting, and governance.
* Ability to convert forecasts and operational assumptions into staffing models and capacity plans.
* Skilled in WFM tools, scheduling platforms, dashboards, productivity metrics, and performance routines.
* Able to identify workforce risks, assess client impact, and drive timely mitigation.
* 6–8\+ years in WFM, operations planning, capacity management, analytics, or client facing delivery leadership.
* Experience with 24/7 operations, multi\-site planning, new site launches, ramp plans, or regulated service environments.
* Proficient in Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Domo, SQL, or similar tools for reporting, dashboards, and workforce insights.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

 Seeking a Manager/ Deputy Manager with strong experience in application security, SDLC governance, and application\-level control analysis to work on engagements involving review of application design, workflows, and system\-driven controls. The role focuses on evaluating how applications are built, configured, and used, through a combination of technical testing, control reviews, and transaction/log analysis.

* Evaluate application architecture and design from a controls perspective
* Assess SDLC processes, including:
* Requirement definition and control embedding
* Workflow configurations, approvals, and validations
* Change management and release governance
* Review application controls such as access management, maker\-checker, and system validations



**Application Analysis \& Testing** 



* Perform application testing (functional, logic, and security\-focused) using manual and automated approaches
* Identify gaps in business logic, workflows, and control configurations
* Review APIs, integrations, and data flows for consistency and control weaknesses



**Data, Logs \& Transaction Analysis** 



* Analyze application logs, audit trails, and transaction datasets
* Trace end\-to\-end transaction flows across systems
* Identify patterns, anomalies, and control bypass scenarios through data\-driven analysis



**Client Advisory \& Reporting** 



* Document findings and provide practical, implementation\-focused recommendations
* Present insights to business, operations, and technology stakeholders
* Support development of control enhancements and design improvements within applications



**Engagement Delivery \& Leadership** 



* Manage engagement delivery (timelines, quality, stakeholder expectations)
* Lead and mentor junior team members
* Contribute to solutioning and practice development initiatives



  





**Technical Expertise** 
 Hands\-on Experience
 


* Application testing (manual and automated), including validation of workflows and controls
* Application logging and monitoring architectures, including audit trails and traceability
* Secure coding concepts (Java, .NET, Python, or similar) to assess control implementation



 Strong understanding of:
 


* OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (from a control/design validation lens)
* Authentication, authorization, and session management mechanisms
* API security and microservices architecture, particularly in relation to data integrity and control enforcement
* Ability to analyze how application behavior aligns with business processes and system controls



**Tools \& Platforms** 




 Exposure to tools such as:
 


* Burp Suite / AppScan / Fortify / Checkmarx (for identifying gaps in implementation and validation logic)



 SIEM / log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar) for application log and transaction analysis
 



**Key skills required:** 



* B.E/ B,Tech or higher qualification in computer science/ IT or any other technology domain with 5 to 8 years of experience .
* Applications security

title: Veterinary pathologist
description:
**Company Description** 
 VETLAB, a division of ALL VET DIAGNOSTIC SOLUTIONS PVT LTD, has been a leader in veterinary diagnostics and imaging in India for over 12 years. With multiple centers nationwide, VETLAB is recognized for delivering reliable, high\-quality diagnostic services that strengthen veterinary care and resilience. As India’s first privately managed veterinary laboratory accredited by NABL and compliant with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 standards, the organization upholds strict quality and accuracy in biological testing. Its extensive service portfolio includes haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, clinical pathology, histopathology, endocrinology, molecular diagnosis, and advanced imaging such as digital X\-rays and ultrasonography. VETLAB serves a wide range of clients, including veterinary hospitals, private clinics, dairy farms, government institutions, race clubs, and security agencies, guided by a deep commitment to animal health and welfare.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Veterinary Pathologist will work full time on\-site at the New Delhi laboratory, providing expert diagnostic support for a variety of animal species. In this role, the individual will perform gross and microscopic examination of tissues, interpret histopathology and cytology results, and prepare clear, timely diagnostic reports for clinicians and partners. Daily responsibilities include correlating clinical findings with laboratory data, collaborating with haematology, microbiology, and molecular diagnostics teams, and participating in quality control and assurance activities to maintain NABL and ISO/IEC standards. The role also involves consulting with veterinary practitioners, contributing to case discussions, supporting the development of diagnostic protocols, and assisting in training team members on pathology best practices. The Veterinary Pathologist will help advance VETLAB’s mission by ensuring accurate diagnoses that guide effective treatment and improve animal health outcomes.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Advanced veterinary pathology expertise, including experience in clinical pathology, histopathology, and cytology, with strong diagnostic interpretation skills.
* Solid grounding in laboratory disciplines such as haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, serology, parasitology, endocrinology, and molecular diagnosis.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, concise, and clinically useful pathology reports, and to communicate complex findings effectively to veterinary professionals.
* Experience working in accredited diagnostic laboratories, with familiarity with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 standards, quality control, and standard operating procedures.
* Commitment to animal welfare, attention to detail, and strong problem\-solving skills in high\-volume, time\-sensitive diagnostic environments.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, manage multiple cases simultaneously, and maintain professional ethics and confidentiality.
* Masters of Veterinary Patholgy and minimum 2\-3 years experience in similar field

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.


**Cloud Infrastructure**
* Design, develop, and troubleshoot automation jobs for complex workflows across AWS accounts and regions.
* Create and assign Jira tasks to drive progress with clear ownership and follow‑through.
* Create and maintain wiki documentation / README files for workflows, procedures, and tooling enhancements.
* Identify gaps in runbook coverage and author new runbooks that enable repeatable, reliable operations.
* Display mastery of service(s) within a single pillar (e.g., Networking, Compute, Storage, Security, Orchestration).

title: NPD (New Product Development) Lead-Product & Design
description:
**Role: NPD (New Product Development) Lead –** 
 Product \& Design  
 



**Team:** 
 New Product Development 
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Founder 
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Hybrid) 
 



  
 



  





**About Nurturing Green** 
  
 



  





 Nurturing Green is India's leading gardening lifestyle brand, making plants and gardening products accessible to millions of customers through Retail, E\-commerce and Quick Commerce. 
 



  





 Featured on
 **Shark Tank India Season 4** 
 , we are present across Amazon, Flipkart, Blink it, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket, Myntra and multiple offline retail formats, with an aggressive vision to become India's most loved gardening brand. 
 



  





 We believe great products are born where design, functionality, and storytelling come together. We're looking for a design\-first creative leader who can shape the next generation of Nurturing Green products and create collections that customers love. 
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 
  
 



  
 


* We are looking for an
 **NPD Lead** 
 who combines strong creative thinking with hands\-on product development, category knowledge and execution capabilities.
* The role will own the product journey from
 **concept to sampling, refinement, costing, packaging, production readiness and launch** 
 , while also driving the visual communication of products across catalogues, e\-commerce and marketing touchpoints.
* Working closely with the Founder, Product/Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales and Marketing teams, the NPD Lead will ensure products are creatively strong, commercially viable and operationally ready for scale.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 
  
 



  





**1\. Product Development \& NPD** 
  
 


* Identify new product opportunities through consumer insights, market trends, category gaps and business requirements.
* Translate ideas and trends into commercially relevant product concepts and collections.
* Develop concepts, sketches, mood boards, specifications, prototypes and samples.
* Build cohesive collections across plants, planters, home décor, gifting, lifestyle and related categories.
* Own the NPD process from
 **concept → sourcing → sampling → iteration → costing → final approval → production readiness → launch** 
 .
* Maintain product specifications, BOMs, dimensions, material details and NPD documentation.
* Manage sampling cycles and resolve design, functionality, quality and production issues.



  





**2\. Category, Material \& Manufacturing Knowledge** 
  
 


* Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories, materials and manufacturing processes.
* Evaluate materials, construction methods, finishes and production techniques based on design, cost and feasibility.
* Work with vendors and manufacturers to identify practical and commercially viable solutions.



  





**3\. Vendor, Sourcing \& Cross\-functional Coordination** 
  
 


* Work closely with Purchase, Merchandising and vendors throughout the development cycle.
* Brief vendors on product concepts, specifications, materials, finishes and packaging requirements.
* Evaluate samples and drive revisions until products meet the required design and quality standards.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Warehouse, Sales,and Operations to ensure smooth product development and launch.
* Proactively manage timelines, dependencies, and development challenges.



  
 



**4\. Packaging Design \& Product Communication** 
  
 


* Lead the design and development of
 **product packaging, labels, inserts, tags, sleeves, boxes and other product communication elements** 
 .
* Ensure packaging balances
 **brand presentation, functionality, product protection, cost and production feasibility** 
 .
* Lead or guide the development of
 **product catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives, Quick Commerce creatives and marketing graphics** 
 for new products and collections.
* Ensure product features, specifications, USPs and visual communication are accurate and consistent across customer\-facing touchpoints.



  
 



  





**5\. Team Management** 
  
 


* Lead and mentor Junior Product Designers and other NPD resources.
* Set clear briefs, timelines, and development expectations.
* Conduct regular product and design reviews.



  





**Core Requirements** 
  
 


* **5–8 years of experience** 
 in Product Design, Product Development, NPD, Category Development, or a similar role within consumer/lifestyle brands.
* Strong experience taking products from concept through sampling and production.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, product development, and collection building.
* Hands\-on experience with vendors, manufacturers, and sampling cycles.
* Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, construction, finishes, and product costing.
* Experience in categories such as home décor, lifestyle, gifting, ceramics, hardgoods, furniture, accessories, handicrafts, gardening products or similar consumer products.
* Good understanding of packaging design and development, including production\-ready artwork, materials,timelines, finishes, and vendor coordination.
* Experience with catalogues, product presentations, e\-commerce creatives or marketing graphics is preferred.
* Strong creative and aesthetic sensibility with the ability to translate trends into commercially relevant products.
* Ability to manage multiple NPD projects and timelines independently.
* Graduate/Postgraduate from NID, NIFT, Srishti, Pearl Academy, MIT Institute of Design or equivalent design/product development institutes preferred.
* Candidates from pure fashion/apparel design backgrounds are not preferred unless they have significant hardgoods/lifestyle product development experience.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; Canva and AI\-assisted design workflows are preferred.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 
  
 


* Develop differentiated and commercially relevant product collections.
* Move products efficiently from concept to production and launch.
* Build strong vendors and manufacturing relationships.
* Maintain high standards of product quality, design, and functionality.
* Deliver products within expected cost and timeline parameters.
* Ensure packaging and product communication effectively support the product proposition.
* Enable smooth collaboration across NPD, Design, Purchase, Merchandising, Warehouse, Sales, Marketing and Operations.
* Strengthen Nurturing Green's product portfolio through a balance of creativity, category knowledge, functionality, manufacturability and commercial viability.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 
  
 


* The ideal candidate sits at the intersection of Creative \+ Product \+ Operations.
* They should be able to identify an opportunity, understand the category, conceptualize a product, develop and sample it, work with vendors, evaluate costing and feasibility, solve production challenges, develop packaging and product communication, and coordinate internal teams through launch.
* They should be equally comfortable discussing design concepts, materials, samples, costing, packaging, specifications, vendor feasibility and launch requirements.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.

title: Content Strategist & Scriptwriter
description:
**About StartupGyaan** 




 StartupGyaan is one of India's established business and startup media brands, with:
 


* 495K\+ YouTube subscribers
* 275K\+ Instagram followers
* 165K\+ FounderGyaan YouTube subscribers
* 91K\+ FounderGyaan Instagram followers



  





  





 We've been building content around startups, businesses, founders and entrepreneurship for nearly a decade. We also work closely with prominent founders and business families across India, creating their content and personal brands.
 



  





 But we're not satisfied with where we've reached.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can help us build the next version of StartupGyaan.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Content \& Growth Lead who can take ownership of StartupGyaan's content strategy and help us build a high\-growth, personality\-driven business media brand.
 



  





 Your first and most important mandate will be: Make StartupGyaan's Instagram Reels impossible to ignore.
 



  





 You'll be responsible for understanding what makes people stop scrolling, developing repeatable content formats and IPs, building a strong brand persona, and eventually expanding that strategy into podcasts, long\-form YouTube and other formats.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll simply receive a content calendar and execute it.You'll be expected to think, experiment, analyse, fail, learn and build.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Instagram Reels — Primary Responsibility
 


* Develop the overall short\-form content strategy for StartupGyaan
* Identify topics, trends, narratives and formats with high potential
* Develop strong hooks and storytelling structures
* Create and improve scripts
* Develop repeatable Reel formats/IPs
* Analyse performance and continuously optimise content
* Study retention, shares, saves, comments and follower conversion
* Identify why certain content works and why other content doesn't
* Build a system capable of consistently producing high\-performing organic content



  





 2\. Build the StartupGyaan Brand \& Personality: We don't want StartupGyaan to remain just another "startup/business facts" page. You will help develop:
 


* Brand personality
* Tone of voice
* Content philosophy
* Storytelling style
* Point of view
* Recurring themes
* Founder/personal\-brand integration
* Distinctive content formats



  





 The goal is to make people recognise:"This is StartupGyaan"even before they see the logo.
 



  





 3\. Build Arnab's Personal Brand: A major part of this role will be developing the founder's presence within StartupGyaan. You'll work closely with Arnab to develop:
 


* His on\-camera personality
* Opinions and points of view
* Storytelling style
* Recurring personal\-brand formats
* Founder\-led content
* Business commentary
* Behind\-the\-scenes content
* Thought leadership



  





 The objective is to create a genuine connection between Arnab and the audience, rather than having StartupGyaan feel like a faceless media page.
 







 4\. Content IP Development: You will be expected to build repeatable content properties, not just individual viral Reels. For example:
 


* Business breakdown formats
* Founder stories
* Business controversies
* Contrarian opinions
* Business economics
* "How this company actually makes money"
* Indian business stories
* Founder insights



  





 You'll constantly ask:"Can we turn this into a format that we can make 100 times?"
 



  





 5\. Analytics \& Growth: You will own the content performance dashboard. Track:
 


* Views
* Reach
* Watch time
* Retention
* Shares
* Saves
* Comments
* Follower growth
* Follows per 1,000 views
* Format performance
* Topic performance
* Hook performance



  





 And most importantly:Turn data into decisions. We don't want monthly reports saying
 *"This Reel got 300K views."* 
 We want:"This format worked because X. Let's make five variations next week."
 



  





  





 6\. Podcast \& Long\-Form — Eventually Once the short\-form engine starts working, you'll gradually take ownership of:
 


* FounderGyaan Podcast positioning
* Episode concepts
* Guest selection
* Interview formats
* Storytelling
* Clips
* Distribution strategy
* YouTubeLong\-form concepts
* Titles
* Thumbnails
* Packaging
* Storytelling
* Retention
* Content series



  





 The objective is to eventually build a content ecosystem, rather than treating Instagram, YouTube and podcasts as separate businesses.
 



  





 7\. Research \& Trend Intelligence: You should be someone who naturally spends time consuming content. You'll be expected to constantly study:
 


* Indian creators
* Global creators
* Business/finance creators
* Emerging Instagram formats
* YouTube formats
* Gen\-Z content behaviour
* Trending narratives
* New content IPs
* Competitor strategies



  





 You should know what is working today and have an opinion on what might work six months from now.
 



  





 8\. Work With the Existing Team. You'll work closely with:
 


* Reel editors
* Videographers
* Content strategists
* Operations
* Founder



  





 You won't necessarily edit every video yourself. Instead, you'll own the creative direction and quality bar.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-have:
 


* 3–6 years of experience in content, creator economy, digital media or social media
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels and short\-form content
* Proven experience growing social media pages organically
* Excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling and retention
* Strong scripting ability
* Strong content ideation ability
* Understanding of social\-media analytics
* Ability to identify patterns from content performance
* Excellent communication skills
* Strong business/current\-affairs awareness
* Ability to work independently and take ownership



  





**Strongly Preferred** 




 We'd love to see candidates who have:
 


* Personally grown a creator/media page
* Worked with a prominent creator
* Generated 10M\+ organic views
* Built a recurring content format/IP
* Experience in business, finance, startup or entrepreneurship content
* On\-camera experience
* Experience with YouTube Shorts
* Experience building personal brands



  





 Proven results matter more to us than degrees or fancy job titles.
 



  





 What We Don't Want
 



 This is important enough that I'd put it in the job post.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone whose primary experience is:
 



 ❌ Posting content according to a calendar
 



 ❌ Managing brand pages mechanically
 



 ❌ Copy\-pasting trends
 



 ❌ Writing generic motivational scripts
 



 ❌ Following viral audio trends without understanding why they work
 



 ❌ Creating monthly social\-media reports without taking action
 



 ❌ Waiting for instructions
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can say:"I think we should completely change this."—and then prove why.
 



  





**Requirements:** 



* Laptop
* Ability to work full\-time from office
* Self\-driven, curious, and detail\-oriented
* Minimum 1 year experience in content writing / scripting / digital content



  





**\- Office Location: 📍Chhatarpur, New Delhi (5 Days in Office, Saturday is Work from Home)**

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
**Senior Video Editor, AI \& Video Automation** 




 📍 Pitampura, Delhi \| Full\-Time \| 3\+ Years Experience \|
 



  





 Cut fast. Scale faster. Turn one script into fifty videos.
 



  





 We don't need someone who edits one polished video a week. We need someone who can take a single brief, run it through AI tools like Higgsfield, and come back with twenty variations worth testing.
 



  





**About Jolt** 




 Jolt is building a fast\-growing consumer app with ambitions to scale across India and international markets. We're a lean, high\-ownership team, with no committees and no layers of sign\-off — just people who own outcomes end to end.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Jolt needs a constant stream of fresh video content across Meta Ads, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and the old way of editing one video at a time can't keep up. We're looking for a video editor who can combine real editing craft with AI\-driven video tools to produce content at volume, without every video feeling like a copy\-paste. You'll be the person turning a single idea into a full set of testable creative variations.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 01 Video Editing \& Craft
 


* Edit ad creatives, social videos, and YouTube content end\-to\-end, with strong pacing, sound design, and visual storytelling.
* Maintain a consistent editing style and brand feel across every format, from a 6\-second Reel to a longer YouTube piece.



  





 02 AI Video Production \& Automation
 


* Use AI video tools such as Higgsfield and similar platforms to generate, automate, and scale video production beyond manual, one\-at\-a\-time editing.
* Build repeatable workflows and templates that let you (or the wider team) turn a single script or brief into many videos quickly.



  





 03 Scaling Content for Testing
 


* Turn a single brief or script into multiple ad variations, different hooks, formats, and aspect ratios, built for rapid A/B testing.
* Iterate fast on what's working, producing new variations based on performance rather than gut feel alone.



  





 04 Cross\-Platform Formatting
 


* Produce and format videos for Meta Ads, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long\-form, respecting each platform's best practices.



  





 05 Collaboration \& Feedback Loops
 


* Work closely with the marketing team to understand what's performing and translate that feedback into the next batch of edits.



  





 06 Asset \& Workflow Management
 


* Keep an organised library of raw footage, templates, and brand presets, so the production pipeline stays fast as volume grows.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* 90 Days: You've mapped the current video workflow, set up AI tooling like Higgsfield, and delivered your first batch of scaled creative variations.
* 6 Months: Video output has scaled up meaningfully without sacrificing quality, and you're consistently producing multiple testable variations every week.
* 12 Months: You own a video production system that keeps performance marketing fed with fresh creative at scale, and can point to specific videos that drove real results.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio spanning ads, social content, and organic video.
* Hands\-on experience with AI video tools such as Higgsfield or similar platforms, for generating, automating, or scaling video production.
* Strong command of standard editing software (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent).
* Experience producing high volumes of short\-form video for Meta Ads, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
* A real understanding of what makes content perform, including hooks, pacing, and retention, and comfort iterating based on data rather than instinct alone.
* Ability to build repeatable workflows and templates for producing video at scale, not just one\-off edits.
* A strong sense of storytelling, pacing, sound design, and visual style.
* A bias for speed and volume, without letting quality slip.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with motion graphics or basic 3D tools to add polish to key creatives.
* Experience building automated or batch\-processing pipelines for video production, beyond manual editing.
* A portfolio or reel showing before\-and\-after examples of AI\-assisted edits or scaled campaigns.
* Experience in a startup or high\-growth environment.
* Someone who has personally driven real results through their edits before — higher CTR, more views, better engagement, or more conversions — and can speak to exactly how they did it.



  





**Location** 




 On\-site at our office in NSP, Pitampura, Delhi.
 



  





**Ready to Cut This?** 




 Send your resume with a reel or portfolio, and a short note on a video or campaign where AI\-assisted editing helped you scale output. Tell us what results it drove.
 



 📍 Jolt · NSP, Pitampura, Delhi

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* Part of the Aditya Birla Financial Service Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9 th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans
* ABHFL operates in the Rs. 11\.4 trillion Indian Housing Finance market, which has grown at a steady rate of 17% CAGR over the last 3 years while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of newer entrants in niche segments like affordable housing and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and has remained stable at \~37% as on December 2015
* The nature of the HFC business (dealing largely with retail customers in the potentially sensitive area of housing/ mortgages), along with the additional regulatory and control mechanisms imposed as a result, means it is imperative that all functions and processes align and comply with sound risk management guidelines and applicable regulations/ controls proactively and judiciously. This is vital for managing risk and protecting interests of both the business as well as the customer


**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* The Risk team provides core underwriting services fundamental to the ABHFL business health, risk management and sustainability. Structured as a dual to the Sales/ Sourcing team, with positions mapped against corresponding Sales roles across the organization, the Risk team is responsible for necessary controls and process checks to ensure business performance and health
* While the core responsibility for this function is to control the business via robust underwriting and risk management, supporting business expansion via joint evaluation of different product/ market growth proposals with the Sales team is also an important contribution
* The Credit Manager plays the role of executing risk and credit operations in line with established guidelines and norms, and securing the organization against diverse risks in local business operations via process measures and checks. This role is responsible for ensuring robust and efficient creditworthiness and risk assessment. He/ She is the “ears on the ground” member of the Risk Team who meets every customer as part of the underwriting process and also visits the property which is being funded. Therefore, he/she needs to have an understanding of the Legal and Valuation framework to be able to perform their role satisfactorily


**Key Challenges**
* While the ABFL Mortgages team also works with retail customers in the property space, the ABHFL business is exposed to the additional Construction Risk, i.e. risk from under construction projects not getting completed as planned. The Risk Team must factor for this when designing and implementing control mechanisms, and evaluating business proposals
* ABHFL is in its inception phase as a company and in the midst of rapid growth. The Risk function must therefore be able to balance priorities of risk management and business growth efficiently, without increasing sub\-prime exposures or impacting business health and sustainability
* The housing space is characterized by state\-wise norms and business practices, as well as varied interpretations of regulatory guidelines by different stakeholders. title: Fulfilment Intern
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Fulfilment Intern** 
 to support the end\-to\-end processing of visa applications and learn how high\-quality travel operations work at scale.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with our regional operations team to review applications, track cases, coordinate across stakeholders and support customers through the visa process.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, on\-ground internship where attention to detail, reliability and a willingness to learn matter every day. The role is based in\-office and operates on a 6\-day work week.
   

  

**The Job**
* Support customers through the visa process by helping communicate requirements, documentation and next steps.
* Review visa documentation for completeness and accuracy, escalating issues or missing information when needed.
* Coordinate across teams and external stakeholders to help keep applications moving and support communication with consulates and embassies.
* Track application progress closely and help ensure customers receive timely updates on status and required actions.
* Support accurate and reliable execution by maintaining customer data confidentiality and contributing to a smooth experience from start to finish.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are hungry to learn, take ownership and build real\-world experience in a fast\-moving environment.
* Are detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks without losing accuracy.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
* Are comfortable using digital tools, learning new systems and figuring things out quickly.
* Are proactive, dependable and willing to get hands\-on with whatever it takes to keep things moving.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*
