title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Role Summary** 




**Manage the end\-to\-end HR lifecycle for the blue\-collar workforce — hiring, onboarding, attendance, statutory compliance, engagement and retention — across on\-roll and contractual staff at the site.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




*Recruitment \& Sourcing* 



* Fulfil bulk hiring for operators, helpers, machine attendants, drivers, loaders, housekeeping and security roles
* Build and manage sourcing channels: local referrals, ITIs, labour contractors, staffing vendors, job melas, field networks and hiring apps such as Apna and WorkIndia
* Screen candidates, run walk\-in drives, coordinate trade tests and roll out offers

*Onboarding \& Documentation* 



* Verify Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, address proof, medical fitness and police verification where applicable
* Complete joining formalities, ID and access cards, PPE issuance and safety induction
* Maintain accurate employee master data in the HRMS



*Attendance, Payroll \& Vendor Management* 



* Manage biometric attendance systems, shift rosters, overtime and leave records
* Share monthly payroll inputs and resolve wage and deduction queries
* Track contractor invoices, headcount reconciliation and vendor SLA performance



*Statutory Compliance \& IR* 



* Ensure compliance with PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Factories Act and Shops \& Establishment Act
* Maintain statutory registers and muster rolls; support labour inspections and audits
* Handle disciplinary matters, show\-cause notices, domestic enquiries and grievance redressal
* Liaise with workers' committees and unions to maintain healthy industrial relations



*Engagement \& Retention* 



* Drive attrition control initiatives, exit interviews and stay conversations
* Run welfare activities covering canteen, transport, restrooms, safety drives, festival celebrations and reward programs
* Act as the first point of contact for worker grievances



*Reporting* 



* Publish daily and weekly dashboards on manpower, absenteeism, attrition and compliance to management



**Requirements** 



* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR or MSW preferred
* 2–5 years handling a frontline or blue\-collar workforce in manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, retail or facility management
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory filings
* Fluency in Hindi and the local regional language along with working English; strong ground\-level communication
* Proficiency in Excel and HRMS or attendance software
* Willingness to work in shifts and travel to nearby sites



**Preferred** 



* Experience managing large headcount and multiple contractor vendors
* Exposure to a unionised environment or multi\-site operations



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* **Manpower fill rate • Time\-to\-hire • Monthly attrition % • Absenteeism % • Statutory compliance score • Payroll input accuracy**

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Application Engineer, Aladdin Product Engineering, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
 At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Application Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global Aladdin Accounting Retail fund operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise\-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. You’ll also help the team explore and adopt emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering and Generative AI, where they can meaningfully improve engineering productivity, operational workflows, or user experience.
   

  

**About Aladdin Accounting**
* Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing commercial product businesses within Aladdin.
* A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments.
* Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations.
* Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and Kafka to manage high\-volume, real\-time data.
* Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business\-critical capabilities.
* Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop robust, high\-performance back\-end systems using Java 21\+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
* Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands\-on approach.
* Build and maintain microservices and event\-driven systems to process and distribute large\-scale financial data with API\-first approach.
* Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real\-time streaming platforms.
* Implement and optimize Redis\-based caching and data stores for low\-latency access patterns.
* Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning.
* Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem\-solving, and design thinking.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI and GenAI capabilities where appropriate to improve software development, operational efficiency, and user experiences, while maintaining strong standards around security, validation, and maintainability.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes.


**Qualifications / Competencies**
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in Java and object\-oriented design.
* Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modelling.
* Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence.
* Hands\-on exposure to Kafka or similar publish\-subscribe systems for real\-time event processing.
* Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming).
* Exposure to Generative AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, AI\-assisted development, or agentic AI patterns.
* Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud\-native environments (AWS/GCP).
* Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
* Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis.
* Interest in applying AI capabilities responsibly within enterprise software and engineering workflows.
* Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Sr Engineer IT Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**
 A Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, secures, and scales an organization's core technology systems across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines deep hands\-on expertise across enterprise compute, storage, and virtualization with knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* System Reliability, Monitoring \& Capacity Planning: Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable systems across hybrid and cloud environments. Define SLIs/SLOs, build out the monitoring and observability roadmap, and analyze resource usage to forecast and manage capacity as traffic and data grow.
* Infrastructure as Code, Automation \& CI/CD: Architect and maintain end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines and code\-driven infrastructure, automating provisioning and reducing manual operational work to enable rapid, safe, and repeatable delivery.
* Hybrid \& Cloud Platform Engineering: Serve as technical lead for the full lifecycle of on\-prem and cloud\-based resources — compute, storage, backup, and virtualization — and design secure, cost\-effective cloud architectures, including migration of on\-premises workloads to the cloud.
* FinOps \& Cost Optimization: Drive FinOps best practices by monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing cloud spend, including cost allocation and reporting.
* Advanced Troubleshooting \& Incident Response: Serve as the final escalation point for high\-impact technical challenges, providing Tier 3 support and leading incident response to minimize downtime across on\-prem and cloud systems.
* Security \& Compliance: Maintain a strong security baseline across platform and cloud services and ensure compliance with standards such as SOC 2 and PCI\-DSS.
* Mentorship, Collaboration \& Documentation: Guide and mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE/DevOps best practices; partner with development, architecture, and security teams, and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards.


**Key Skills \& Qualifications**
* Compute \& Storage Skills
* 10\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure engineering experience, with a proven track record in global enterprise environments.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across Operating Systems (Windows and Linux), enterprise storage, backup (Veeam or similar), and virtualization/hyper\-converged systems (Nutanix), including physical infrastructure in on\-prem or hybrid environments.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) and core security practices (SSL/TLS, SSH, encryption, LDAP).
* Experience with configuration management (Chef, Ansible, Puppet) and orchestration platforms (CloudBolt, Rundeck).
* Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, Shell, PowerShell) to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
* Relevant industry certifications (Microsoft, Red Hat, Nutanix, VMware, backup/storage, Cisco, or security\-related) are a plus.
* Cloud Skills
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, database, and security services; multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud experience preferred.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager) and cloud networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity).
* Experience leading migration of on\-premises applications and data to the cloud.
* Demonstrated experience driving FinOps strategies to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance or security.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS).
* Professional\-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem\-solving skills, with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences, and a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle.


**Education**
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and work\-related experience.

With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

title: Zonal Admission Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Zonal Admission Manager – North Zone
   

  

 Company: ODM Educational Group
   

 Position: Zonal Admission Manager
   

 Zone: North Zone
   

 Base Location: Gurugram, Haryana
   

 Travel Requirement: Mahendragarh, Kotputli and other North Zone school locations as required
   

 Reporting To: Senior Management / Zonal Leadership
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 About the Role
   

  

 ODM Educational Group is looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Zonal Admission Manager – North Zone to lead and oversee admission operations across multiple schools within the assigned zone.
   

  

 The candidate will be based at Gurugram and will be responsible for managing admission performance across the existing schools in Gurugram, Mahendragarh, Kotputli, and additional schools that may be added to the North Zone in the future.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will act as the central point of coordination between the management and individual school admission teams, ensuring that every school achieves its monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly and annual admission targets through structured outreach, counselling, follow\-up, conversion and parent engagement.
   

  

 The role requires strong leadership, sales and admission management capability, data\-driven decision\-making, excellent communication skills and the ability to build a high\-performance admission culture across multiple locations.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Zonal Admission Target \& Performance Management
   

  

 \- Take complete ownership of admission targets for all schools under the North Zone.
   

 \- Translate annual admission targets into half\-yearly, quarterly and monthly actionable targets for each school.
   

 \- Monitor school\-wise:
   

 \- Enquiries
   

 \- Leads
   

 \- Walk\-ins
   

 \- Counselling
   

 \- Applications
   

 \- Admissions/Enrollments
   

 \- Conversion ratios
   

 \- Follow\-ups
   

 \- Lost leads
   

 \- Pending cases
   

 \- Scholarship cases
   

 \- Identify gaps against targets and implement corrective action plans.
   

 \- Ensure consistent admission performance across all schools rather than focusing only on individual high\-performing locations.
   

 \- Prepare and present regular performance reviews to senior management.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Leadership of School Admission Teams
   

  

 Each school will have its own Admission Manager and Counselling Team.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will:
   

  

 \- Guide, monitor and review the performance of each School Admission Manager.
   

 \- Ensure that Admission Managers are executing the approved admission strategy and outreach calendar.
   

 \- Ensure counsellors are following the prescribed calling, counselling and follow\-up protocols.
   

 \- Review daily/weekly/monthly performance reports.
   

 \- Conduct regular review meetings with school admission teams.
   

 \- Identify training requirements and arrange/coordinate coaching for Admission Managers and Counsellors.
   

 \- Ensure accountability for lead management, follow\-up and conversion.
   

 \- Promote coordination between Admission Managers and Counsellors for seamless execution.
   

 \- Ensure that the school admission team operates independently while remaining aligned with zonal objectives.
   

  

 Note: The role will focus specifically on admission operations and performance. The Prodigy/academic operations team will remain outside the direct admission function, while coordination may be required wherever it impacts student acquisition or parent communication.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Outreach \& Lead Generation
   

  

 Ensure that every school has a strong and continuous outreach program.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will monitor and guide school teams in executing:
   

  

 \- Residential society outreach programs
   

 \- School visits and student engagement programs
   

 \- College and institutional outreach
   

 \- Career fairs
   

 \- Education fairs
   

 \- Parent engagement programs
   

 \- Student engagement activities
   

 \- Community outreach
   

 \- Corporate/community tie\-ups
   

 \- Local events and social activities
   

 \- Referral programs
   

 \- Digital and social\-media\-led lead generation initiatives
   

 \- Brand promotion activities
   

 \- Local area marketing initiatives
   

  

 Ensure that every Admission Manager maintains a structured monthly outreach calendar with measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Outreach should not be activity\-driven alone; it must generate quality leads and contribute to admission conversion.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Counselling \& Parent Engagement
   

  

 Ensure that the counselling team follows a standardized and professional counselling protocol.
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that counsellors:
   

  

 \- Make timely calls to all assigned leads.
   

 \- Follow up regularly and systematically.
   

 \- Maintain proper lead records and follow\-up history.
   

 \- Understand the requirements and concerns of parents.
   

 \- Provide accurate and transparent information.
   

 \- Handle parent objections professionally.
   

 \- Explain the admission process clearly.
   

 \- Explain applicable scholarships and eligibility criteria.
   

 \- Ensure timely application and enrollment.
   

 \- Maintain continuous engagement with prospective parents until closure.
   

 \- Provide appropriate post\-enrollment communication and support.
   

  

 The objective should be to create a professional, informative and trust\-based parent experience rather than a purely sales\-driven interaction.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Walk\-in \& Admission Conversion Management
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that every school follows a standardized walk\-in management process.
   

  

 Parents/clients visiting the school should receive complete information regarding:
   

  

 Academic Journey
   

  

 \- Pre\-Primary
   

 \- Primary
   

 \- Secondary
   

 \- Senior Secondary
   

 \- Higher education opportunities, wherever applicable
   

 \- Integrated/long\-term educational pathways within the ODM ecosystem
   

  

 Competitive \& Career Preparation
   

  

 Where applicable, parents should be appropriately informed about opportunities for:
   

  

 \- JEE preparation
   

 \- NEET preparation
   

 \- Other competitive examination support
   

 \- Career\-oriented academic programs
   

  

 Holistic Development
   

  

 The counselling team should effectively communicate the school's opportunities for:
   

  

 \- Sports
   

 \- Music
   

 \- Singing
   

 \- Basketball
   

 \- Cricket
   

 \- Volleyball
   

 \- Swimming
   

 \- Horse riding
   

 \- Other extracurricular activities
   

 \- Student engagement programs
   

 \- National and international\-level participation and recognition
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will ensure that such information is communicated accurately, consistently and in accordance with approved school/group communication.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Application, Enrollment \& Post\-Enrollment Process
   

  

 Ensure that the complete admission journey is managed smoothly:
   

  

 Lead → Contact → Counselling → Follow\-up → Walk\-in → Application → Scholarship/Financial Discussion → Enrollment → Post\-Enrollment Support
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Ensuring timely application processing.
   

 \- Monitoring pending applications.
   

 \- Ensuring proper documentation.
   

 \- Monitoring enrollment timelines.
   

 \- Tracking admission drop\-offs.
   

 \- Following up on incomplete cases.
   

 \- Ensuring accurate fee/course communication.
   

 \- Ensuring parents receive proper information regarding applicable fees and policies.
   

 \- Coordinating with relevant school departments for a smooth post\-enrollment experience.
   

 \- Identifying reasons for admission cancellations or drop\-outs and developing corrective measures.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. Data, MIS \& Admission Analytics
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager must establish a strong data\-driven admission management system.
   

  

 Regularly monitor:
   

  

 \- School\-wise target vs achievement
   

 \- Lead generation
   

 \- Lead source
   

 \- Calling performance
   

 \- Contactability
   

 \- Walk\-in ratio
   

 \- Application ratio
   

 \- Conversion ratio
   

 \- Counsellor\-wise performance
   

 \- Admission Manager\-wise performance
   

 \- School\-wise performance
   

 \- Scholarship cases
   

 \- Pending applications
   

 \- Lost leads
   

 \- Admission cancellations
   

 \- Revenue/fee realization, where applicable
   

  

 Prepare:
   

  

 Daily / Weekly
   

  

 Operational performance tracking and critical follow\-up review.
   

  

 Monthly
   

  

 School\-wise target vs achievement and performance review.
   

  

 Quarterly
   

  

 Trend analysis, strategy review and corrective action plan.
   

  

 Half\-Yearly
   

  

 Zonal performance evaluation and strategic planning.
   

  

 Annual
   

  

 Complete North Zone admission performance analysis and next\-year planning.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Review \& School Visits
   

  

 The base location will be Gurugram, but the candidate must be willing to travel periodically to schools under the North Zone.
   

  

 Expected locations may include:
   

  

 \- Gurugram
   

 \- Mahendragarh
   

 \- Kotputli
   

 \- Other North Zone locations added in the future
   

  

 During school visits, the Zonal Admission Manager will:
   

  

 \- Review admission performance.
   

 \- Meet the Admission Manager and Counselling Team.
   

 \- Audit lead and follow\-up records.
   

 \- Review outreach activities.
   

 \- Evaluate parent/walk\-in handling.
   

 \- Identify operational gaps.
   

 \- Conduct performance reviews.
   

 \- Provide on\-ground guidance and training.
   

 \- Ensure implementation of management directives.
   

 \- Develop location\-specific action plans.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 9\. Strategy \& Business Development
   

  

 The Zonal Admission Manager will contribute to the development of the North Zone admission strategy by:
   

  

 \- Identifying local market opportunities.
   

 \- Understanding parent/student demographics.
   

 \- Identifying high\-potential catchment areas.
   

 \- Developing school\-specific lead\-generation strategies.

 \- Building institutional/community relationships.
   

 \- Studying competitor activities and local admission trends.
   

 \- Recommending new marketing and outreach initiatives.
   

 \- Supporting new school launches from an admission perspective.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 10\. New School Integration
   

  

 As ODM Educational Group expands its presence in the North Zone, additional schools may be added under the Zonal Admission Manager.
   

  

 The incumbent will be responsible for supporting the admission setup of new schools, including:

 \-\-\-

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.

 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Senior Platform Engineer** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Candidates should be based out of Delhi NCR / Bhopal)
 



**Experience:** 
 6\-10 years total · 3\+ years owning platform architecture or data infrastructure in production
 



**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending, fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



 We are in scale\-up mode \- shipping fast, onboarding customers continuously, and standardizing the platform engineering patterns that compound across every customer and product line.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on engineering role with architectural ownership. You will spend the majority of your time designing and writing code, not running a program office and not managing a team. You will take ambiguous requirements from customer environments \- undocumented schemas, legacy ERP systems, inconsistent data quality and turn them into reliable, repeatable platform capability.
 



 You will operate with a high degree of independence, make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy calls, and be accountable for how the platform performs, scales, and stays up in front of customers.
 



**What You'll Do** 




**1\. Platform Architecture \& System Design** 



* Own the architecture of Sutra.AI’s core platform services \- service boundaries, API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across the stack.
* Translate solution and customer requirements into concrete engineering approaches, reference architectures, and build sequences the wider team can execute against.
* Design for multi\-tenancy, scale, and reuse so that platform capability built for one customer generalizes to the next.
* Proactively challenge architectural gaps, evaluate technical feasibility, and make pragmatic build\-versus\-configure decisions with clear trade\-off reasoning.
* Drive technical decisions through design documents, architecture reviews, and working prototypes rather than opinion.



**2\. Data Infrastructure \& Pipelines** 



* Design, build, and operate ingestion pipelines from diverse customer systems \- ERP, CRM, MES, relational and non\-relational databases, files, and APIs.
* Own batch and streaming data processing, orchestration, transformation layers, and the storage architecture underneath analytics and AI workloads.
* Build data quality, schema\-drift detection, lineage, and reconciliation controls so downstream models and dashboards can be trusted.
* Model relationships between operational systems, workflows, and data sources where documentation does not exist, and formalize what you discover.
* Optimize query performance, storage cost, and pipeline throughput as data volumes and customer count grow.
* Build and maintain the data foundations that AI workloads depend on, including retrieval, embedding, and feature pipelines.



**3\. Security, Governance \& Multi\-Tenancy** 



* Implement tenant isolation, access control, secrets management, and encryption standards across platform and data layers.
* Build the governance controls \- audit trails, retention, PII handling \- required to operate credibly in enterprise and regulated customer environments.
* Partner with engineering leadership to align platform practices to compliance frameworks relevant to our customers.



**4\. Engineering Standards \& Technical Leadership** 



* Establish platform engineering standards, reusable components, internal libraries, and documentation that raise the whole team’s throughput.
* Mentor engineers through design discussions, code review, and pair programming; lead by example on code quality.
* Identify engineering and operational risks early, design mitigation plans, and resolve them with stakeholders rather than only reporting them.
* Collaborate with Implementation, Solutioning, and Product teams so platform decisions stay tied to customer value and delivery timelines.



**Requirements** 




**Must\-Have** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6\-10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years owning platform, infrastructure, or data engineering systems in production.
* Demonstrated architecture ownership \- you have designed systems end to end, not only implemented someone else’s design.
* Strong backend engineering skills in Python (and comfort with Node.js/TypeScript services), including APIs, async systems, and distributed architectures.
* Deep data engineering experience: ETL/ELT design, batch and stream processing, orchestration, and warehouse or lakehouse modelling.
* Strong SQL and database engineering \- schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning across relational and NoSQL stores.
* Hands\-on cloud experience (AWS primary; Azure or GCP acceptable) including compute, storage, managed databases, networking, and IAM.
* Working experience with containerization, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership: systems you shipped independently from problem statement to production and then operated.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills across layers \- data quality, application behaviour, infrastructure, and system design.
* Ability to work through ambiguity: undocumented systems, incomplete requirements, and competing priorities across concurrent engagements.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in startups or fast\-growth product environments with high ownership and low process overhead.
* Experience building platform or data foundations for AI/ML workloads \- retrieval systems, vector stores, feature or embedding pipelines.
* Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS platform experience.
* Exposure to enterprise system integration (ERP, CRM) and to industrial domains such as manufacturing, supply chain, or production.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2\) and enterprise security review processes.
* Open\-source contributions, published technical writing, or internal platform tooling you built and others adopted.



**Core Technical Competencies** 




**Languages:** 
 Python (primary), SQL, TypeScript/JavaScript; Bash for automation
 



**Data Engineering:** 
 Airflow or equivalent orchestration, dbt, Spark, Kafka or similar streaming, batch and incremental pipeline design
 



**Storage \& Query:** 
 PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, object storage, columnar warehouses, Trino or equivalent query engines
 



**Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC) primary; Azure/GCP secondary; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 



**DevOps \& Reliability:** 
 CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, monitoring and alerting, logging and tracing, incident response
 



**APIs \& Services:** 
 REST and GraphQL design, FastAPI, Node.js/Express, event\-driven and microservices patterns, authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT)
 



**AI Platform Exposure:**

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager on BCG’s IT HR Systems Group, you will serve as a hands\-on configuration expert across Workday, with deep focus on Advanced Compensation—designing, building, and maintaining salary, bonus, eligibility rules, and cycle frameworks—while also supporting configuration across Core HCM, Security, and other modules as needed to ensure cohesive, scalable system design aligned with business strategy. * Bachelor’s degree in human resources or information systems with 7\+ years of deep, hands\-on configuration experience with Workday Advanced Compensation and Core Compensation is a must
* Strong Understanding of merit pools, compensation review statements, proration rules, complex scorecards, grade setups, eligibility rules, etc. and integration points with Core HCM, Talent modules and third\-party payroll systems is a must
* Certification, such as Workday Pro \- Advanced Compensation, is strongly preferred.
* Prior Consulting experience as a Workday Comp Lead or an architect role on end\-to\-end implementation projects is strongly preferred
* Prior experience with large, global companies with complex enterprise\-scale comp implementations in Workday is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans to ensure high quality before deployment is preferred
* Familiarity with Workday Docs and BIRT to build templates and control dynamic field visibility, and with Workday Security Configuration, is preferred
* Technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues, are preferred
* Skilled in stakeholder management, offering training and support to end\-users during annual compensation cycles while delivering exceptional customer service year\-round for L3 support items is preferred


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager will join a team of:
   

  

* Other members of the HR IT team, including the Workday Delivery Team, the Comp squad, and other squads under the People Portfolio
* Global Comp stakeholders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
* QA Teams for testing on specific enhancements and software releases


 Additional info
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
 Plan and Execute Comp Configuration: Design and build intricate variable pay, merit, bonus, allowances, including compensation review statements, and the overall coordination of events within Workday.
   

  

 Cycle Management: Own the end\-to\-end execution of Annual Salary Reviews, mass operation management, and merit grid setups.
   

  

 Business Processes: Configure Business Process Frameworks (BPF), condition rules, validations, and complex calculated fields.
   

  

 Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Product Team and HR/Compensation leaders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
   

  

 Testing: Perform Testing, validate self and peer configurations, and troubleshoot system defects during Workday releases.
   

  

 Documentation: Create clear and comprehensive specification documents for application modifications and new functionality additions, for Workday
   

  

 Data Integrity \& Audits: Ensure the accuracy of compensation data and maintain internal compliance and audit processes.
   

  

 Workday Technology: Stay abreast of functional \& development tools, including Workday AI offerings, trends and practices, and act as an evangelist for items that should be considered for future initiatives
   

  

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Minfy Tech is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Security Architect to join our team. In this role, you will be a critical leader in helping our customers migrate their on\-premise environments to AWS while transforming and enhancing their security posture. Your primary responsibility will be to analyze our customers' existing IT landscapes, understand their security and network architectures, and design secure and scalable AWS solutions. You will be instrumental in helping customers modernize their security infrastructure, including migrating from legacy firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and adopting SD\-WAN technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Security Architecture Design:
* Assess customers' existing security and network architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective AWS cloud solutions aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Develop detailed security architecture diagrams, documentation, and migration plans.
* Recommend and implement security enhancements and transformations, such as moving to VM\-series firewalls and SD\-WAN.
* Cloud Security Implementation:
* Configure and deploy AWS security services (e.g., IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, VPCs, Security Groups, NACLs) to protect workloads in the cloud.
* Implement and manage security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and web application firewalls (WAFs).
* Automate security configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Security Transformation:
* Lead the transformation of customers' security posture from traditional models to modern, cloud\-centric approaches.
* Provide expertise in migrating from port\-based firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN technologies.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies to isolate workloads and minimize the attack surface.
* Risk Management and Compliance:
* Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify security gaps in the cloud environment.
* Develop and implement security policies, standards, and procedures to ensure compliance with industry regulations (e.g., HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR).
* Participate in security audits and compliance reviews.
* Collaboration and Communication:
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including cloud engineers, developers, and project managers.
* Communicate security requirements and best practices to stakeholders at all levels.
* Provide security training and mentorship to other team members.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in security architecture, with a focus on cloud security and AWS.
* Strong understanding of network and security architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Deep expertise in AWS security services and best practices.
* Experience designing and implementing security solutions for cloud migration projects.
* Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, CIS, ISO 27001\).
* Familiarity with security tools and technologies, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and SIEM solutions.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform).
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty or equivalent certification is highly preferred.
* Experience migrating from traditional firewalls to VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN solutions.
* Experience with cloud security automation tools.
* Experience working with enterprise customers.

title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
 Protsahan India Foundation operates 5 centres in Delhi, with 50\+ staff, each managing their own devices, alongside shared infrastructure — CCTVs, biometric attendance systems, WiFi networks, and programme equipment. As we scale, formal IT management is required for each of the 5 centers and the administrative office location.
   

  

 The IT Systems Administrator will own all of this — not as a helpdesk ticket\-taker, but as the person who makes sure none of it fails. You will be the single point of accountability for IT infrastructure, device health, data security, and digital compliance across all locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Device Management
* Manage 50\+ laptops across 6 locations: setup, configuration, asset tagging, condition tracking, maintenance, and repair
* Maintain the IT asset register per Protsahan’s asset management SOPs — every device tracked by location, user, and condition
* Coordinate hardware procurement: obtain quotes, recommend vendors, and process purchase requests through Finance
* Manage device allocation for new joiners and secure retrieval at exit — within the timelines defined in HR SOPs
* Initiate and document write\-off requests for end\-of\-life devices per the disposal policy
* Network and Connectivity
* Manage WiFi, LAN, and internet connectivity at all 6 centre locations
* Troubleshoot network outages and connectivity issues; escalate to ISP vendors where required
* Maintain router and network device configurations; document network topology for each location
* Coordinate with ISP vendors on service quality, renewals, and upgrades
* CCTV Systems
* Maintain and monitor CCTV infrastructure at all 6 locations
* Manage CCTV storage: ensure recording continuity, footage retention per policy, and periodic storage health checks
* Control access to CCTV footage — only authorised personnel per the IT and Data Protection Policy
* Coordinate with CCTV vendors for installation, repair, and expansion
* Biometric Attendance Systems
* Maintain biometric attendance devices at all locations; ensure data sync and accuracy
* Coordinate with HR on attendance data extraction and troubleshoot device failures
* Manage device firmware and software updates; coordinate vendor support for hardware issues
* IT Helpdesk and Staff Support
* First\-line IT support for all 50\+ staff across 6 locations — hardware issues, software queries, account access problems
* Respond to support requests within 24 hours; resolve or escalate within 3 working days
* Provide hands\-on support at centre locations through scheduled visits (minimum monthly) and emergency visits when required
* Conduct basic IT literacy orientation for new staff on Day 1 as part of the onboarding process
* Google Workspace Administration
* Administer Protsahan’s Google Workspace: create and deactivate user accounts, manage shared drives, set access permissions
* Enforce the Shared Drive folder structure per ADM SOPs — ensure staff create and store files in Shared Drive, not personal My Drive
* Manage storage quotas, conduct periodic access audits, and generate usage reports for ED
* Troubleshoot Google Workspace issues for staff
* IT Security and Data Protection Compliance
* Enforce Protsahan’s IT and Data Protection Policy across all locations
* Implement and maintain password policies, device locking, and access control practices
* Support compliance with DPDP Act 2023 requirements — data inventory, access logs, incident response
* Conduct quarterly IT security audits across all 6 locations and report findings to ED
* Manage software licensing: track all licences, renewals, and compliance — no unlicensed software on Protsahan devices
* Programme Equipment Support
* Support Canon DSLR camera geotagging setup at all GECs: Canon Camera Connect app pairing, Location Services configuration, and staff training per SOP\-EE\-07
* Troubleshoot programme AV equipment, projectors, and other tech used in GEC activities
* Ensure camera and device firmware is kept up to date
* Vendor Management
* Maintain a vendor register for all IT service providers: ISP, hardware, CCTV, biometric, software
* Obtain comparative quotes for hardware and service procurement per Finance SOPs
* Monitor vendor service quality and SLA compliance; escalate persistent issues to ED


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field
* 2 to 4 years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, or IT helpdesk
* Hands\-on experience managing Google Workspace (user admin, Shared Drive, permissions)
* Working knowledge of WiFi and LAN network management
* Experience with CCTV systems and/or biometric attendance devices
* Basic understanding of data protection and IT security principles
* Ability to work independently across multiple locations with minimal supervision
* Willingness to travel across all 6 Delhi centre locations as required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience in an NGO or social sector organisation
* Familiarity with DPDP Act 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection) requirements
* Experience with asset management and maintaining IT asset registers
* Relevant certifications: CompTIA A\+, Google Workspace Administrator, or equivalent


**What We Expect**
 This role is not a 9\-to\-5 desk job. When the biometric device at a centre fails on a Monday morning, you are the person who resolves it — not who logs a ticket and waits. You will be expected to:
   

  

* Be responsive. Staff across 6 locations depend on functional equipment to run their programmes.
* Be proactive. Don’t wait for things to break — maintain, audit, update.
* Own the documentation. Every device, every vendor, every access permission must be on record — not in your head.
* Understand the stakes. Protsahan works with vulnerable children. IT failures have programme consequences. Data breaches have child protection consequences.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
KSS is looking for a dynamic and passionate Field Service Engineer to assist KSS commission membrane systems purchased by clients, maintain existing systems, audit customer processes and troubleshoot technical problems. We will provide on the job training and a great team atmosphere. The right person must be open to learning, taking feedback and be proud of the work that they perform.
   

  

 Working closely with KSS process engineering, controls engineering, and project management this role will allow cross\-disciplinary learning in a variety of industries in which KSS membranes and systems play critical roles.
   

  

 KSS’ Field Service Engineers become the face of the company while on site; recommending spare parts and service solutions to improve machine uptime, maintenance and operation, as well as managing documentation to help improve internal and external processes.
   

  

 When not traveling, the Field Service Engineer will perform service tasks including, but not limited to, troubleshooting customer issues via telephone, email and online meetings, preparing system documentation, and supporting KSS’ pilot system program.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Capable of performing service activities on membrane systems comprised of various technologies such as MBR, UF, NF and RO filtration both in person and remotely.
* Organize and prioritize schedule in accordance with customer requirements to determine needs for immediate attention, onsite visits, and remote assistance.
* Travel to customer sites to perform system commissioning, maintenance, auditing and troubleshooting.
* Participate in and conduct customer training sessions.
* Troubleshooting areas include: electrical, mechanical, and digital (both PLC code and HMI applications).
* Manage system documentation to ensure accurate data recording, making process recommendations as needed.
* Collaborate with Quality, Process and Design Engineering to improve test methods and find resolution for identified problems.
* Conduct site inspections to ensure installation compliance with KSS drawings and specifications.
* Maintain accurate service logs and enter them in system database.
* Answer KSS’ technical services telephone line, supporting customers remotely as they call for troubleshooting.
* Assist in preparing KSS pilot systems for customer trials.


 All other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or 3\+ years experience in electrical and mechanical troubleshooting.
* Excellent customer focus with ability to reliably respond to inquiries, communicate and interact with all client levels.
* Excellent verbal, written, MS Office, computer, technical data, and networking communication and presentation skills, with ability to communicate complex technical issues in an easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Experience with ladder logic and HMI applications preferred
* Experience with electrical troubleshooting preferred
* Excellent organizational skills with ability to work independently, prioritize, multi\-task, follow through, and meet deadlines within an entrepreneurial and customer\-focused work environment.
* Familiarity of quality management systems (ISO 9001 or ISO 13485\)
* Ability and willingness to travel within the United States approximately 50% as required.
* Limited travel to other regions may also be required.
* Exemplify willingness and flexibility in working differing time shifts to accommodate customer needs.
* Hands\-on experience with PLC systems a plus.


 Exhibit strong leadership, time management, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

**Physical Requirements**
* Must be able to ascend and descend ladders, stairs, and in proximity to loud equipment.
* Must be able to lift and carry or otherwise move up to 50 pou nds frequently.
* Must be able to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Must be able to wear personal protective gear including but not limited to: safety\-toed footwear, safety vests, safety eyewear, fall harnesses, hearing protection, etc.
* Must be able to work on feet for extended periods of time.


 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

 Career Roadmap: Dependent on the individual’s career goals. Following passion is important at KSS, future roles after field service often leads to process engineering, project management, controls engineering, manufacturing engineering, and other areas that are available within KSS.
