title: Q Commerce Key Account Manager
description:
**KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER – QUICK COMMERCE \& MARKETPLACES** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 years, preferably in D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty or consumer products
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹40,000–₹50,000 per month
 



**Role:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 Gytree is looking for a hands\-on Key Account Manager to own and grow our Quick Commerce and marketplace business. We are looking for someone at the early\-to\-mid career level who already understands this ecosystem, has strong working relationships within key platforms, and has the ambition and capability to independently run and grow the vertical.
 



  





 The person should have hands\-on knowledge of platforms including Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon Now, Flipkart, BigBasket/BB Now, Nykaa and other emerging commerce platforms. They should understand the complete business cycle, from platform relationships and onboarding to logistics, inventory, advertising, pricing, promotions, data and revenue growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Own the day\-to\-day management and growth of Gytree across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon Now, Flipkart, BigBasket/BB Now, Nykaa and other relevant commerce platforms.
2. Have existing working relationships and contacts across Q\-commerce and marketplace organisations, including category managers, account managers, buying teams and other relevant decision\-makers, and be able to leverage these relationships to build the business.
3. Act as the internal owner of the Q\-commerce vertical, with the ability to independently manage platform relationships, operations, advertising, inventory, data and growth.
4. Understand and manage the complete Q\-commerce operating cycle including SKU onboarding, listings, inventory movement, purchase orders, replenishment, availability, warehousing and fulfilment.
5. Ensure high product availability and minimise stock\-outs across platforms, cities, warehouses and dark stores through regular monitoring, forecasting and proactive replenishment.
6. Track inventory levels, sell\-through, stock cover, ageing inventory, fast\-moving SKUs and replenishment requirements on a daily basis.
7. Understand Q\-commerce advertising thoroughly and independently execute, monitor and optimise sponsored listings, search advertising, visibility campaigns and platform\-specific advertising opportunities.
8. Track advertising spends against revenue, ROAS, conversion, CAC and incremental sales to ensure advertising contributes to efficient and profitable growth.
9. Own pricing, discounts, promotions, platform events and visibility opportunities while ensuring commercial decisions remain aligned with overall business objectives.
10. Build and maintain daily, weekly and monthly dashboards covering revenue, units sold, SKU performance, inventory, availability, advertising spends, ROAS, pricing, promotions and platform\-wise growth.
11. Analyse performance by platform, SKU, geography and time period and identify where the business is growing, slowing down or losing potential sales.
12. Maintain accurate datasets and records for sales, inventory, advertising, commercial terms, platform contacts, POs, claims and ongoing operational issues.
13. Track competing brands across Q\-commerce and marketplaces, including their assortment, pricing, promotions, visibility, advertising, new launches and platform presence, and convert these observations into actionable insights.
14. Identify opportunities to expand Gytree into new cities, dark stores, platforms, categories and consumer cohorts based on data and platform potential.
15. Work closely with supply chain, operations, finance, marketing, performance marketing and content teams to ensure Q\-commerce requirements are anticipated rather than managed reactively.
16. Independently resolve platform issues including listing errors, stock mismatches, pricing discrepancies, PO issues, advertising problems, claims and operational escalations.
17. Build and deepen relationships with platform account managers, category managers and commercial teams and actively pursue better visibility, campaigns, launches, placements and growth opportunities.
18. Stay constantly updated on the Q\-commerce ecosystem, including new platforms, advertising products, algorithms, fulfilment models, consumer behaviour, category trends and successful strategies being used by other consumer brands.
19. Understand the economics of the vertical, including margins, platform commissions, advertising costs, discounts, logistics costs and contribution margins, and use this understanding to make better commercial decisions.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who has
 **actually worked within the Q\-commerce and marketplace ecosystem** 
 , not someone whose experience has been limited to catalogue management or listing products.
 



  





 The candidate should ideally bring
 **existing relationships within Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart, BigBasket/BB Now, Nykaa or similar platforms** 
 and understand how to work with category managers, account managers and buying teams to get things moving.
 



  





 They must be comfortable with numbers, Excel/Google Sheets, inventory planning, advertising dashboards and commercial conversations. They should be able to move comfortably between analysing yesterday's sales, solving today's stock problem and discussing next month's growth opportunity with a platform.
 



  





 Most importantly, this person should have the ability and ambition to
 **run the entire vertical and be part of the growth team** 
 . While this is not a senior leadership hire today, we are looking for someone who can take increasing ownership and grow into independently leading Gytree's Q\-commerce and marketplace business.
 



  





**Success in this role will be measured by:** 
 revenue growth, platform and city expansion, SKU availability, reduction in stock\-outs, advertising efficiency, stronger platform relationships and visibility, accurate reporting, inventory health and the overall growth of Q\-commerce as a meaningful business channel for Gytree.

 Our AI chatbot can be customized with a business's role, knowledge base and information so it can interact with website visitors, answer questions and help businesses capture potential leads.

 \- Identify businesses that could benefit from an AI\-powered website chatbot
   

 \- Reach out to business owners, founders, agencies and decision\-makers
   

 \- Introduce and demonstrate our chatbot solution
   

 \- Explain the product, pricing and benefits to potential customers
   

 \- Follow up with interested prospects
   

 \- Close customers and help them get started
   

 \- Build your own sales pipeline through LinkedIn, calls, networking and other channels

 What we offer
   

  

 \- Performance\-based earning opportunity
   

 \- Customer\-based performance incentives
   

 \- 20% commission on qualifying purchases made by customers you bring

 \- No limit on the number of customers you can bring
   

 \- Product training, demo access and sales material will be provided
   

 \- Remote work
   

 \- Opportunity to continue as a long\-term sales/channel partner based on performance
   

  

 Who we're looking for
   

  

 This opportunity may be a good fit for:
   

  

 \- Business Development professionals
   

 \- Sales professionals
   

 \- Digital marketing professionals
   

 \- Freelancers
   

 \- WordPress/web developers
   

 \- Web design agencies
   

 \- Digital marketing agencies

 Important compensation information

 The role is structured as a performance\-based independent partnership.

 Ideal candidate

 \- Proactive and self\-driven
   

 \- Comfortable communicating with business owners
   

 \- Confident with online sales and outreach
   

 \- Able to work independently
   

 \- Interested in AI, SaaS and digital marketing
   

 \- Focused on generating actual business rather than simply registering for a partner program

title: Data Access Governance Lead
description:
**Position Title:** 
 Data Access Governance Lead
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Regular \- Full\-Time
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 43418
   

  

**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences \- together. With a customer\-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**
**About The Role.**
 As part of McCain’s digital transformation journey, we are making significant investments in our data structures, governance practices, and enterprise data capabilities to improve data quality, strengthen confidence in decision\-making, and unlock value through the effective use of data.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Data Access Governance Lead** 
 to join our Global Data Governance team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating McCain’s enterprise\-wide data access governance framework, ensuring the right people have the right access to the right data at the right time. The successful candidate will establish and maintain role\-based access controls (RBAC), safeguard sensitive information, support regulatory and audit requirements, and enable secure and efficient data usage across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing.**
* Define and maintain enterprise data access governance policies, standards, and RBAC frameworks aligned to data classification and sensitivity levels.
* Design and govern role and entitlement models that align business responsibilities with appropriate data access rights while minimizing access sprawl.
* Ensure access governance frameworks adhere to segregation\-of\-duties and least\-privilege principles.
* Partner with data platform, engineering, and security teams to implement access controls across enterprise data platforms, data lakes, analytics platforms, and reporting tools.
* Establish and oversee access request, approval, provisioning, and de\-provisioning processes.
* Lead periodic user access reviews, certifications, and recertification exercises with data owners and stewards.
* Monitor and remediate access risks such as orphaned accounts, dormant access, excessive privileges, and policy violations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for data access governance inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder engagement activities across regions and business units.

title: Computer Aided Design System Administrator
description:
**Job Description \- CAD Administrator (SolidWorks \& PDM)** 




**Role Focus:** 
 SolidWorks CAD Administration \& Support \| SolidWorks PDM Administration
 



**Company: Client of D'GenMinds** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a Senior CAD Administrator with 5\-6 years of relevant experience to administer and support both the SolidWorks CAD application environment and SolidWorks PDM. The role combines hands\-on SolidWorks CAD application administration and engineering\-user support with SolidWorks PDM administration and support. The administrator will ensure stable CAD
 



 performance, controlled engineering data, consistent standards, reliable integrations, and
 



 responsive support for engineering teams.
 



  





**Role Scope** 




 Area Primary Focus
 



 SolidWorks CAD Administration \& User Support
 



 Installation/configuration, licenses, templates/libraries, performance, crashes, assemblies, references, workstation and user support SolidWorks PDM Administration \&
 



 Support Vaults, workflows, permissions, data cards, lifecycle/revisions, upgrades, migration, performance and PDM user support
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 A.
 **SolidWorks CAD Administration \& Support** 



* Administer SolidWorks, DraftSight, and eDrawings environments including installation,
* configuration, version rollout, patching, and license management.
* Provide L2/L3 support for SolidWorks issues including application launch failures, crashes, slow performance, graphics/display issues, large assembly performance,
* rebuild errors, missing/broken references, open/save problems, add\-in issues, printing/export, and license availability.
* Troubleshoot whether an issue is caused by SolidWorks settings, user profile, CAD model/data, workstation hardware/graphics, network, license server, PDM integration, or server\-side services.
* Manage SolidWorks templates, sheet formats, design libraries, Toolbox/standard parts, routing standards, macros, and controlled CAD settings.
* Support CAD workstation optimization and recommend suitable hardware specifications for engineering workloads.
* Support engineers using SolidWorks Routing (Piping, Electrical, or Tubing) where applicable.
* Document recurring CAD issues and fixes, prepare user guides, and train users on correct CAD practices and performance best practices.



  





**B. SolidWorks PDM Administration \& Support** 



* Administer SolidWorks PDM Professional/Standard environments, including vaults, users/groups, permissions, workflows, lifecycle states, transitions, and data cards.
* Manage revision control, metadata, folder structures, document controls, and engineering release processes in PDM.
* Provide L2/L3 support for PDM user issues including login/access, check\-in/check\-out, transitions, permissions, file visibility, references, metadata/data cards, and vault performance.
* Support PDM server/client upgrades, version compatibility, patching, testing, rollout, and rollback planning.
* Participate in PDM implementation, data cleanup, migration, metadata mapping, reference validation, and controlled cutover activities.
* Monitor PDM performance and coordinate with database, network, infrastructure, and vendor teams when issues cross system boundaries.
* Maintain PDM technical documentation, support procedures, knowledge articles, and change records.
* Shared Responsibilities
* Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and changes through ITSM processes and tools.
* Coordinate testing and user acceptance before production CAD/PDM changes.
* Work with engineering, IT, global locations, and external partners to resolve crosssystem issues.
* Identify recurring problems and implement permanent improvements to reliability and user productivity.
* Required Qualifications
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Engineering IT, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 5\-6 years of relevant experience with hands\-on administration/support of SolidWorks and SolidWorks PDM. Candidates should demonstrate meaningful experience in both areas, not only design or end\-user usage.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* • SolidWorks administration and end\-user troubleshooting: installation, configuration, licenses, templates/libraries, performance, crashes, large assemblies, references, and workstation issues.
* SolidWorks PDM administration: vaults, workflows, permissions, data cards, lifecycle/revisions and production support.
* Strong practical understanding of SolidWorks design/drafting and how CAD data behaves in a managed PDM environment.
* Experience with upgrades, deployments, implementation and/or data migration.
* Knowledge of CAD workstation hardware, graphics considerations, network dependencies and application performance troubleshooting.
* Structured incident troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, documentation and user communication.
* Preferred Skills
* SolidWorks Routing experience.
* API, macros, scripting or automation exposure.
* ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM tool experience.
* Multi\-site/global PDM implementation exposure.
* Experience supporting manufacturing engineering teams.



  





**Success Measures** 



* Stable SolidWorks and PDM availability with timely user support.
* Reduced repeat incidents through root\-cause fixes and CAD/PDM standardization.
* Consistent templates, libraries, permissions and engineering release processes.
* Controlled upgrades and migrations with minimal engineering disruption.

title: Platform Engineer - OpenStack
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cloudstrats is an Indian exponential technology product company that builds Artificial Intelligence platforms powered by analytics and automation. Its solutions use computer vision, speech, and text technologies to address complex real\-world challenges for government and enterprise customers. The company’s platforms apply Deep Learning, NLP, and ML to support sustainable development goals across sectors such as citizen services, public safety, education, health, and transport. Cloudstrats delivers marquee projects including command control centers, e\-governance solutions, grievance redressal platforms, data hubs, fraud detection, and health systems. The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation
* Configure centralised logging, audit collection, and alert escalation



 Resilience, Backup \& Recovery

title: Nutanix Migration Engineer
description:
**Details:**
 The Nutanix Migration Engineer is the technical executor of the VMware\-to\-Nutanix transition. The role spans the full migration lifecycle \- assessment and sizing, migration design, Nutanix Move 6\.0 execution, cutover, validation, troubleshooting, and post\-migration stabilization. This is a delivery\-focused engineering role: the expectation is independent, hands\-on execution inside a production healthcare environment where failed cutovers and extended outages are not recoverable events. The engineer must be equally comfortable on the VMware source side and the Nutanix target side, because the majority of migration failures originate in the source estate rather than the destination.
   

  

 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**
* Perform discovery of the source VMware estate using Nutanix Collector, RVTools, and native vCenter reporting \- capturing VM inventory, resource consumption, disk layout, snapshots, VMware Tools state, guest OS versions, and network configuration.
* Analyze workload characteristics to identify migration blockers before scheduling: unsupported guest operating systems, RDMs, shared VMDKs, oversized disks, encrypted VMs, VMs with attached ISOs, static IP dependencies, application clustering, and licensing anchored to hardware identifiers.
* Support target sizing and capacity planning using Nutanix Sizer \- validating CPU, memory, storage, and node count against actual measured consumption rather than allocated values.
* Group workloads into migration waves by application dependency, business criticality, downtime tolerance, and owner availability; document per\-wave migration approach and rollback plan.
* Produce the migration design and cutover runbook for each wave: pre\-checks, sequence, validation steps, back\-out procedure, and named approvers.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain Nutanix Move 6\.0 \- appliance sizing, source and target environment registration, credential and permission configuration, and network mapping between source port groups and AHV virtual networks.
* Build and execute migration plans: seed data replication, monitor replication progress and lag, manage bandwidth and concurrency limits, and coordinate cutover timing with application owners.
* Manage guest preparation \- VirtIO driver injection for Windows guests, Linux guest readiness, VMware Tools removal, and IP retention or reassignment per the network design.
* Execute cutovers within approved change windows, including final delta sync, source VM shutdown, target power\-on, and confirmation of guest boot, network reachability, and service startup.
* Handle migration exceptions where Move is not the right tool \- in\-guest methods, backup\-and\-restore migration via the client's backup platform, database\-native replication, or rebuild\-and\-reinstall for legacy or unsupported workloads.
* Execute post\-migration validation: guest OS health, VirtIO device and driver state, disk presence and capacity, network and DNS resolution, application service startup, backup job re\-registration, and monitoring agent check\-in.
* Troubleshoot migration failures across the stack \- Move appliance and agent errors, CBT and snapshot issues, vCenter permission and API failures, source datastore performance limits, boot failures on AHV (UEFI/BIOS mismatch, missing drivers, disk controller changes), and post\-cutover network isolation.
* Coordinate application owner validation and formal acceptance sign\-off for each migrated workload; drive open defects to closure within the agreed hypercare window.
* Perform post\-migration optimization: right\-sizing CPU and memory, storage container and compression/dedupe policy alignment, VM affinity rules, and protection policy or replication configuration on the target.
* Decommission source objects only after acceptance and retention criteria are met, following the agreed decommissioning checklist.
* Maintain as\-built documentation, migration logs, exception records, and lessons learned; contribute reusable runbook content back to the Stefanini Nutanix practice.
* 5\+ years in enterprise virtualization or infrastructure engineering, including 2\+ years hands\-on with Nutanix in production.
* Demonstrable participation in at least one completed enterprise VMware\-to\-Nutanix migration \- candidates must be able to describe scale, tooling, failure modes encountered, and how they were resolved.
* Required certification: Nutanix Certified Professional \- Multicloud Infrastructure (NCP\-MCI), current version.
* Preferred: Nutanix Certified Master \- Multicloud Infrastructure (NCM\-MCI), VMware Certified Professional \- Data Center Virtualization (VCP\-DCV), Microsoft or Red Hat OS\-level certification.
* Experience in a healthcare or other regulated production environment, working within formal change control and maintenance windows.

We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. * Develop business process maps, functional specifications and user stories.

* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, controls and timetable expectations.

* Lead governance forums and Go/No\-Go decision processes.

****Process Responsibilities \- Automation \& Innovation****

* Promote standardisation and reusability across actuarial processes.

title: Associate Director- New Delhi
description:
****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).
   

  

****About The Position****
 The Associate Director provides strategic, technical and operational leadership for Jhpiego India's Cancer, control portfolio. The position is responsible for shaping the overall program strategy, developing new business opportunities, ensuring high\-quality implementation across multiple states, strengthening partnerships with governments and donors, managing large multidisciplinary teams, and driving innovation and evidence generation.
   

  

 The position will play a critical role in positioning Jhpiego as a national leader in comprehensive Cancer control and NCD programming by integrating service delivery innovations, digital technologies, implementation science, health financing approaches and public\-private partnerships.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
**Strategic and Technical Leadership**
* Provide strategic vision and technical leadership for Jhpiego's Cancer and NCD portfolio across India.
* Develop long\-term strategic plans aligned with national priorities and global commitments on cancer care continuum and NCD control.
* Provide strategic guidance on implementation of WHO and Government of India guidelines for cancer screening and NCD management.
* Lead the design of innovative service delivery models across prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment, survivorship and palliative care.
* Support development of national and state operational guidelines, SOPs, training packages and quality standards.
* Promote integration of digital health, AI\-enabled diagnostics, telemedicine and innovative technologies into program implementation.
* Identify emerging opportunities and position Jhpiego as a preferred technical partner for governments and development agencies.
* Provide strategic oversight for integration of common cancers into Comprehensive Primary Health Care platform.


**Program Management, Budgets, and Donor Compliance**
* Manages program work plans, budgets, and donor deliverables, ensuring compliance with philanthropic and institutional requirements.
* Oversees risk management and ensures timely, high\-quality delivery against agreed milestones.
* Provide oversight of multiple national and state\-level projects within the Cancer and NCD portfolio.
* Ensure timely achievement of project deliverables, quality standards, donor compliance and contractual obligations.
* Lead annual work planning, budgeting, forecasting and financial monitoring.
* Oversee program risk management and ensure effective mitigation strategies.
* Monitor portfolio performance through data\-driven decision making and adaptive management.


**Government and Partnership Engagement**
* Build and strengthen strategic partnerships with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, National Health Mission and State Governments
* Engage with national technical institutions, professional societies, academic organizations and regulatory bodies.
* Representing Jhpiego in national technical working groups, policy forums and advisory committees.
* Strengthening collaborations with private healthcare providers, diagnostic companies, pharmaceutical, diagnostic partners and civil society organizations.

title: Founder's Office - Strategy & Operations
description:
The Founder's Office – Strategy \& Operations plays a critical role in enabling senior leadership to operate effectively across multiple initiatives, organizations, and time zones. This is a high\-trust, high\-responsibility role designed for someone who combines strong organizational capability with excellent presence of mind, discretion, and proactive thinking.
 



  





 The role requires close partnership with leadership to manage complex schedules, coordinate priorities, and ensure continuity across meetings, decisions, and follow\-through actions. You will serve as a key operational anchor, helping leadership maintain clarity, momentum, and focus in a fast\-moving environment.
 



  





 This is not a purely administrative role. It requires sound judgment, strong communication ability, intellectual curiosity, and the capacity to anticipate needs, often going beyond routine expectations to support strategic execution with maturity and discretion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Leadership Office Support \& Confidentiality***



* Handle sensitive information with strict confidentiality and professionalism.
* Exercise sound judgment and prudence in handling sensitive or evolving situations.
* Provide proactive support that allows leadership to focus on strategic priorities.



  





***Communication \& Research Support***



* Prepare agendas, briefing notes, and relevant background information ahead of meetings through structured research and synthesis.
* Conduct research and gather insights that support leadership decision\-making and strategic preparation.
* Draft clear, professional communications, summaries, and follow\-up correspondence when required.



  





***Executive Scheduling \& Coordination***



* Manage complex calendars and schedules across multiple time zones, ensuring effective prioritization and sequencing of commitments.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, travel plans, and leadership engagements.
* Maintain oversight of leadership priorities and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts.



  





***Meeting Support \& Operational Follow\-Through***



* Attend meetings alongside leadership when required to capture key discussions, decisions, and action points.
* Track follow\-ups and ensure timely execution across stakeholders and initiatives.
* Serve as a coordination point between leadership and internal teams or external partners.
* Maintain continuity across projects and conversations to ensure momentum.



  





**Leadership Office Expectations** 




  





 This role sits within the Founder's Office and requires a high degree of trust, discretion, and ownership. The successful candidate will act as a dependable extension of leadership, anticipating needs, maintaining situational awareness, and ensuring execution follows intent.
 



  





 The role requires flexibility to align with leadership schedules across geographies and time zones, and comfort working in dynamic environments where priorities may shift quickly. The ability to think ahead, exercise prudence, and make smart judgment calls beyond standard instructions is essential.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





  




* Exceptional organizational and coordination skills with strong attention to detail.
* 5 \- 10 years of experience in Strategy, Founder's Office or similar fast\-paced roles in startups.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, professional communication confidently.
* Strong research ability and skill in synthesizing information into actionable insights or briefing notes.
* High level of prudence, situational awareness, and independent judgment.
* Professional presence and confidence in executive settings.
* Ability to remain calm and effective in fast\-moving, high\-pressure situations.
* High level of confidentiality, integrity, and reliability.
* Flexibility in working style and availability to support evolving leadership priorities.
* Comfort using digital collaboration, scheduling, and productivity tools.



  





**Who Will Thrive Here** 




  





 You will thrive in this role if you are highly organized, proactive, and naturally inclined to take ownership without constant direction. You think ahead, communicate clearly, and are comfortable solving problems independently when situations evolve quickly. You value discretion, professionalism, and take pride in enabling others to operate at their best.
 



  





**Growth Opportunity** 




  




* Direct exposure to senior leadership decision\-making and strategic operations.
* Opportunity to develop strong capabilities in executive management, coordination, research, and strategic communication.
* High visibility role with meaningful impact across multiple initiatives.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further
   

  

 International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced person to join the WPB Premier Services Team
   

  

**Role Purpose**
* The HSBC Premier offering is one of the world’s first globally linked banking offerings. And of strategic importance for HSBC, the role requires you to be part of premier relationship team across branches
* The role provides dedicated support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRM) in the overall achievement of their income plans (covering acquisition, cross sales, retention, and growth of their portfolios) and day to day contact with their clients in the delivery of the proposition objectives
* In order to deliver client centric service the role also requires you to be a point of contact for clients as and when required and provide customer with a memorable service experience by having a problem solving attitude


 In addition, the Premier Officer may provide credit/lending support to the PRM if dictated by market requirements. Building an ongoing relationship based on value and service is critical to being successful in this role.
   

  

 In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to demonstrate an extensive knowledge of banking products and services across wealth and retail.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
**Impact on the business**
* Provide high quality sales support to a team of PRMs mainly focused on getting appointment for PRMs and supporting PRMs in servicing their clients
* Reduce the time spent on process and administrative tasks by PRM to increase PRM’s capacity
* Support PRMs to manage client contact and service, including, in the absence of PRMs, answering client calls, resolving client enquiries on transactional needs and facilitating a smooth hand\-off to the correct channels where appropriate, and managing key event reminders to maintain active client contact
* Provide sales support to PRMs including preparing and completing sales documents, managing data input and report generation, and liaising with support functions to follow through client purchase process requirement


**Clients/Stakeholders**
* Handle client’s enquiries relating to the PRM’s portfolio in a positive, timely, and appropriate manner. Aim to resolve the customer’s queries at the first point of contact and minimise referrals to the PRM for routine transactions.
* Has strong knowledge of the PRM’s portfolio of clients with the support of CRMS and analytical tools
* Proactively responds to client in face\-to\-face and/or telephone settings, updating client profile screens with details of client contact
* Maintains a basic understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services
* Support PRMs to execute suitable solutions for product areas responsible for with clients to fulfill their needs and ensure efficient follow up
* Manager the Premier desk (including required contact activity) in the absence of PRM.
* Assist the PRM in organizing events as and when required.
* Refer the attrition cases to PRM immediately
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to manage Premier TAT / customer expectations


**Leadership and teamwork**
* Communicate effectively and works well with other teams within the Branch, Call Center, HTS, and other relevant partners that impact the client’s experience of HSBC; in order to ensure a consistent approach and application of Premier standards
* Efficiently manages time in order to support different PRMs concurrently
* Proactively identifies opportunities/issues and provides feedback to branch management and HTS to improve products and service processes
* Delivering the firm \- Put the client at the heart of our business and deliver joined up services and solutions aligned to customer needs.


**Operational effectiveness and control**
* Ensure all processes and procedures are accurate and in accordance with HSBC Bank policy standards, regulatory requirements, Group Compliance Policy and Internal Controls.
* Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling
* Zero discrepancies on documentation for new Liability \& Wealth accounts.
* Ensure 100% accuracy on all KYC and Non KYC documentation and processing of customer instructions
* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD \& EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile


**Major Challenges**
* Provide high quality support to PRMs
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures in order to handle client needs
* Proactively help HSBC identify opportunity to improve process efficiencies
* Sensitively redirect clients to the most effective and efficient channel
* Support the client in navigating the channel of their choice (to interact with HSBC) effectively and efficiently
* Ensure the client consistently receives a professional premium service which exceeds their expectations at all times
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations
* Ensuring the highest standards of customer service in terms of timeliness and customer experience.
* Enhancing customer confidence in the bank’s Global Premier proposition by ensuring the offer of a relevant product suite and supporting this through systematic and regular communication is a key aspect of the role.
* given the growth aspirations of the WM business, the jobholder is to constantly source, develop and grow Premier relationships in a highly competitive market. The said role requires to balance customer servicing activity along with sales acquisition while ensuring the necessary growth in the existing portfolio coupled with minimal attrition.
* Another key challenge is to be able to provide superior service to all walk in customers as per guidelines


**Role Context**
 Premier is a key proposition in the bank’s strategy. Over recent years, our business and organisation has made considerable progress both in our performance versus peer group and in our strategic transformation. Over the medium term we have been improving both our profitability and our ability to meet the needs of our target clients.
   

  

 We Have Four Overriding Principles That Will Apply To The Delivery Of All Propositions, Products And Services Through All Channels To All Customers At All Times
   

  

* We will treat all customers fairly
* We will apply the HSBC Group values and business principles in all of our dealings with customers
* We will meet, or exceed, all local and international laws, regulations, and codes of practice
* We will deliver services to customers in a manner that provides speed, ease, certainty and empathy


**Management of Risk**
 Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.
   

  

**Observation of Internal Controls**
 Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.
   

  

**Role Dimensions**
* Has exceptional and updated knowledge of Banking products, systems and processes.
* Is well organized and depicts professional image
* Displays extra\-ordinary Business focus and customer orientation and provides exemplary service
* Is self\-motivated and has the drive to overachieve on goals and targets set out
* Displays close bonding with immediate team members and skillful association with support group colleagues


**Qualifications**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree / Graduation with 2 years of experience
* Holistic understanding of the Branch Operations and Processes of the bank
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements
* Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage


**Additional Information**
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:
Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a highly skilled
 **Senior RPA \& AI Developer** 
 to design, develop, and support intelligent automation solutions using RPA, Generative AI, and related technologies. The role requires strong hands\-on development expertise, solution design capabilities, and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable automation solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy RPA and AI\-enabled automation solutions.
* Build automations using UiPath, Power Automate, or similar platforms.
* Integrate AI/GenAI capabilities such as LLMs, OCR, NLP, and IDP into automation workflows.
* Analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities.
* Develop reusable components, frameworks, and best practices.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards.
* Integrate bots with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services.
* Support production deployments, incident resolution, and enhancement activities.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and support teams during project delivery.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and operational runbooks.


**Required Skills**
 RPA \& Automation
   

  

* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in UiPath and/or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Experience developing attended and unattended automation solutions.
* Strong understanding of Orchestrator, queues, assets, exception handling, and framework\-based development.


 AI \& Emerging Technologies
   

  

* Experience with Generative AI, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, or similar AI platforms.
* Understanding of AI Agents, Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-based solutions.
* Experience with OCR, NLP, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and document understanding.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in Python, C\#/.NET, SQL, and REST APIs.
* Experience integrating with SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle, or web applications.
* Good understanding of Azure services and cloud\-based automation architectures.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer Certification.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure AI Certifications.
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale automation programs.
* Exposure to Process Mining, Task Mining, and Analytics platforms.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
* Ownership mindset with focus on quality and delivery.
* Mentoring junior developers and supporting knowledge\-sharing initiatives

title: Graduate Technology Associate – Freshers
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 Dataseashore Technology is looking for recent technology graduates who are curious, hands\-on and serious about building a career in technology.
 



 This is not a hiring drive for one fixed technology stack.
 



 We are looking for strong early\-career talent first. Based on your aptitude, interests and demonstrated capability, you may work across:
 



  





 • AI \& Generative AI
 



 • Data \& Analytics
 



 • Data Engineering
 



 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python \& Backend Development
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations
 



 • Software Engineering
 



  





 Your technology track can evolve based on your strengths, interests and the problems you are able to solve.
 



  





**WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON** 




  





 Depending on your strengths and assigned technology track, you may work on:
 



  





 • Generative AI and AI applications
 



 • LLMs, RAG and AI agents
 



 • Python development
 



 • Data analytics and data engineering
 



 • SQL and databases
 



 • React, Node.js and MERN applications
 



 • Backend APIs and integrations
 



 • Cloud applications
 



 • Workflow and business\-process automation
 



 • Internal technology products
 



 • Client\-facing technology solutions
 



 • Prototypes that may evolve into production applications
 



  





 You are not expected to know all of these technologies.
 



 We are more interested in your ability to learn, think, solve problems and build.
 



  





**WHO SHOULD APPLY** 




  





 Please apply if you:
 



 • Have completed B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA
 



 • Are a fresher or recent graduate
 



 • Want to build a serious career in technology
 



 • Have basic programming knowledge
 



 • Are comfortable learning new technologies
 



 • Enjoy solving problems
 



 • Can learn independently
 



 • Are willing to work across technologies rather than restricting yourself to one stack
 



 • Are available for full\-time employment
 



 • Are willing to work on\-site in Gurugram
 



 • Are comfortable working in a lean, fast\-moving technology company
 



  





**WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT** 




 We care more about what you have tried to build than how many certificates you have collected.
 



 It could be:
 



  





 • A college project
 



 • A website or web application
 



 • A MERN application
 



 • A Python application
 



 • An AI chatbot or AI agent
 



 • A Data or Analytics project
 



 • An API integration
 



 • An automation workflow
 



 • A dashboard
 



 • A cloud project
 



 • A GitHub repository
 



 • Any technology prototype you built yourself
 



  





 Your project does not need to be perfect.
 



  





 We want to understand:
 



  





 • What did you build?
 



 • What part did you personally work on?
 



 • What problems did you face?
 



 • How did you solve them?
 



 • What did you learn?
 



  





  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 




  





 Learning Ability
 



 Can you understand something unfamiliar and start working with it?
 



  





 Problem Solving
 



 Can you break an unfamiliar problem into smaller pieces and work towards a solution?
 



  





 Curiosity
 



 Do you explore technology beyond your college curriculum?
 



  





 Ownership
 



 Can you take responsibility for completing something?
 



  





 Execution
 



 Do you actually build things rather than only completing courses and certifications?
 



  





 Communication
 



 Can you clearly explain what you have built and how it works?
 



  





  





 POSSIBLE TECHNOLOGY TRACKS
 



  





 Depending on your capability, interests and business requirements, you may begin or grow into:
 



  





 • AI / Generative AI
 



 • Data \& Analytics
 



 • Data Engineering
 



 • Full Stack / MERN
 



 • Python / Backend Engineering
 



 • Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • Automation \& Integrations
 



  





 You do not need to decide your entire technology career before joining.
 



  





 We want to identify people with strong fundamentals and learning ability and then align them with the technology track where they can perform best.
 



  





  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates may be asked to:
 



  





 • Explain something they have built
 



 • Share a GitHub, portfolio or project link
 



 • Solve a basic programming or logical problem
 



 • Work through a real\-world technology use case
 



 • Explore an unfamiliar technology and explain their approach
 



 • Complete a short practical assignment
 



  





 We are not looking for candidates who have memorised hundreds of interview questions.
 



  





 We are looking for graduates who can:
 



  





 THINK. LEARN. BUILD. IMPROVE.
 



  





  





 IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY
 



  





 This opportunity is specifically intended for freshers and recent graduates starting their technology careers.
 



  





 Eligible qualifications:
 



  





 B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA
 



  





 When applying, please include your GitHub profile, portfolio, project link or a short description of something you have built wherever possible.
 



  





  





 ABOUT DATASEASHORE TECHNOLOGY
 



  




* Dataseashore Technology works across AI, Data, Cloud, Automation and Software Engineering, building practical technology solutions for real business problems.

title: Yoga Educators - Breathwork, Yoga Nidra and Mindfulness
description:
**Company Description** 




  





**DownDog India Private Limited** 




  





 India's members\-first wellness club, built with intent.
 



 Not open to all. Not designed for volume.
 



  





**OUR DNA** 




  





**Selective access** 




 Entry is considered.
 



 We build a community, not a crowd.
 



  





**Calm as a standard** 




 Not an outcome. Not an add\-on.
 



 Everything is designed to bring you back to yourself.
 



  





**Yoga is the anchor** 




 Hot. Non\-heated. Breathwork. Stillness.
 



 Every format begins and ends with practice.
 



  





**Built from discipline, not trend** 




 No borrowed ideas. No noise.
 



 What we offer is lived, not packaged.
 



  





**Non\-negotiable Personal and honest teaching, always** 




 Small groups. Constant attention.
 



 You are seen, corrected, guided.
 



  





**Sensory, not superficial** 




 Light, scent, space, silence.
 



 Every detail serves how you feel inside.
 



  





**Cleanliness is non\-negotiable** 




 Immaculate spaces. Every day. Every session.
 



  





**WHAT WE CREATE** 




  





 A space where:
 



  




* you can be with yourself without interruption
* strength builds quietly
* the body softens, the mind steadies
* time feels like your own again



  





**POSITION** 




  





 An exclusive, membership\-only yoga club.
 



 Designed for those who value privacy, depth, and a more intentional way of living.
 



  





**What kind of Yoga Teachers we are looking for?** 




 We are looking for humble but committed souls who share their passion and love for Yoga in following ways:
 



  





 ·      Ability to teach different styles of Yoga across different age groups and market demographics.  You will be specialising in minimum 5 asana forms in addition to meditation and pranayama.
 



 ·      Personally assess Members to determine their level of proficiency of Yoga practice and design Yoga postures sequence to suit our Members requirements.
 



 ·      You bring with yourself a strong work ethics and an internal push to give your best to our Members as they progress through in their Yoga journey.
 



 ·      You need to be internally driven and be an ongoing learner.  We are not looking at 9\-5 mindset.  We are looking for guys who are self\-managed and highly disciplined.
 



 ·      You will have the flexibility to create your own customized yoga sequence depending upon your target Members needs.  But you will have to strictly follow the company’s guidelines for Members safety during practice, Members engagement methodology and best practices in Yoga teaching.
 



 ·      Assist students to achieve proper breathing techniques and alignments.
 



 ·      Ability to take full ownership of our Member’s well\-being and their Yoga journey.
 



 ·      Ability to work in a completely flat Organization. We are strictly not looking for a corporate groomed yoga teacher or one obsessed with turf protection.
 



 ·      Ability to be personal and interactive with the members such that you can build your own community.  We are not looking at ego driven Yoga gurus. Even if you teach HOT Yoga, your teaching delivery cannot be dictatorial but interactive and full of empathy.
 



 ·      Ability to communicate fluently in Hindi, English and must have a witty and inquisitive mind.. 
 



 ·      Ability to make teaching fun and making sure our Members relax, sweat and get a sense of calm accomplishment towards end of each Yoga session.
 



 ·      Personal follow\-up with each Member of ours is mandatory and non\-negotiable.
 



 ·      Respect and courtesy for every person within the club and every Member is must and non\-negotiable.
 



  





**Educational Qualifications and Teaching Experience:** 



* At least Bachelors but Masters in Yoga (preferred) from a credible local and international university.
* Minimum 500 Hours of Yoga Teacher training gained through a registered Yoga school.  But with this you will need to have a credible Yoga teaching experience gained both inside and outside India.  Online teaching Yoga to international clientele does not count.
* Professional certification directly from R. Sharath Jois, Bikram Choudhury, Dharma Mittra, BKS Iyengar, Kathryn Budig, Kino MacGregor, Shiva Rea, Jason Crandell, Baron Baptiste and other globally recognized Yoga Teachers.
* Have conducted teacher training globally.  Online teacher training will not be considered.



  





**If you have what we are looking for, we will love to hear from you.** 




  





**Remuneration:** 




  





 Our remuneration will be benchmarked with the best premium Yoga clubs in the world and will come with substantial perks (some come into play after successful completion of probation period and some after successful work completion at the Club for at least 3 years), which will include but depending upon skills set and teaching experience – attractive base,, travel allowance, opportunity to become part of elite yoga teacher training club, subsidized education to further your Yoga education in India and so forth.
 



  





**For us to evaluate your true potential, please ensure you have included all the following details in your application:** 




  





 ·      Live video of your teaching so that we can hear your voice and heart.  You can pick the aspect of hatha yoga which you love to teach and share with us your teaching style, dialogue, students’ engagement etc. You can either do as a solo or while teaching your class.
 



 ·      Your detailed work profile which highlights your Yoga journey.  We need to hear from you in your own words, why you chose Yoga, why you teach Yoga and what you want to achieve in your life through teaching Yoga.  This is must.
 



 ·      What attracts you to this role, based on what you read in this job description and your personal career goals.
 



 ·      Steps you take to keep yourself up to date with yoga teaching and grow further internally in your\-self yoga practice. In other words, how you fuel your own hunger for Yoga and personal growth.
 



 ·      In your most recent Yoga work assignment, were you Permanently employed or were on Contract? What were your Reasons of leaving?
 



 ·      Most recent salary drawn – base (monthly/class) and variable (commission).
 



 ·      Please attach all your education, work and salaries certificates.
 



  





**Timelines.** 




 We are always looking for excellent candidates.
 



**All applications should be sent to:** 
**apply@downdog.com.sg** 




 We appreciate you taking the time to read and apply.
 



 Namaste!
 



 DownDog Team

title: Graduate Consultant - Geoenvironmental UK
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Location:** 
 India – Bengaluru, Mumbai or Hyderabad
   

  

**Position:** 
 Graduate Consultant – Geoenvironmental and Geotechnical
   

  

**Business Area:** 
 Resilience / Environment / Site Evaluation and Restoration
   

  

**Working Model:** 
 Hybrid
   

  

**About Arcadis**
 Arcadis is a leading global design, engineering and consultancy organisation for natural and built assets. With a strong presence in India through its Global Excellence Centres, Arcadis brings together curious minds to deliver sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and help clients address complex environmental, infrastructure and resilience challenges.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an enthusiastic, detail\-oriented and delivery\-focused Graduate Consultant to join our UK Operations team. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional who is keen to develop technical consulting skills across environmental site assessment, ground investigation data, geotechnical interpretation, reporting, GIS/CAD and multidisciplinary project delivery.
   

  

 You will support projects across sectors such as transportation, energy, water resources, real estate, industrial, manufacturing and technology, working with experienced consultants, engineers and project managers to deliver high\-quality technical outputs for clients in the UK and other global markets.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist in the preparation of Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessment reports, ground investigation summaries and technical deliverables.
* Collate, review and tabulate environmental, geological, hydrogeological and geotechnical data.
* Support the processing and presentation of intrusive site investigation records, including borehole logs, laboratory data and field observations.
* Prepare figures, drawings, plans and basic spatial outputs using GIS/CAD tools, where required.
* Contribute to report writing, data interpretation, technical notes, schedules, charts and project documentation.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams including environmental consultants, geotechnical engineers, planners, designers and project managers.
* Help maintain project records, data management systems, task trackers and quality documentation.
* Deliver assigned tasks on time, within budget and in accordance with Arcadis quality, health, safety and business management requirements.


 About You
   

  

* A degree or postgraduate qualification in Geology, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Hydrogeology or a related discipline.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly.
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and willingness to work with large datasets.
* Basic understanding of environmental site assessment, ground investigation techniques, soil and groundwater data, or geotechnical principles.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel and an interest in data management, GIS, CAD, Power BI or digital tools would be advantageous.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage tasks to agreed deadlines.
* Curiosity, enthusiasm and a proactive approach to learning from senior colleagues and project teams.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Meaningful work on projects that help improve quality of life and support sustainable outcomes for communities.
* Opportunities to work with global teams and gain exposure to international environmental and infrastructure projects.
* Structured learning, mentoring and development to help you build a rewarding consulting career.
* A collaborative, inclusive and supportive culture where every contribution matters.
* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements, subject to project and business requirements.
* Exposure to digital tools, data\-led approaches and multidisciplinary project delivery.


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging
   

  

 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
   

  

 \#JoinArcadis
   

  

 \#CreateALegacy
   

  

 \#Hybrid

title: Application Engineering Director
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
 Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest\-growing businesses within Aladdin and represents a significant strategic investment for BlackRock. The team builds and operates the technology platforms that power accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Our engineers develop business\-critical application, data, reporting, and workflow systems while driving modernization through distributed architectures, advanced data platforms, and engineering innovation. Working closely with Product, Operations, Data, and Engineering partners, the team delivers capabilities that support BlackRock and the broader Aladdin client ecosystem.
   

  

**Your role and impact**
 As an Engineering Director, Application Engineering, you will serve as a senior technology leader responsible for shaping architecture, engineering strategy, and delivery across enterprise\-scale platforms supporting global post\-trade operations. You will connect long\-term technology vision with pragmatic execution, influence critical technical decisions, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders. This role combines deep technical expertise with organizational leadership, enabling you to drive modernization, improve platform resiliency, and deliver meaningful business outcomes at scale.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and drive technology strategy, target\-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader Aladdin strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps, leading modernization initiatives and balancing technical debt reduction with delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade\-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.


**Your Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 12 years of demonstrated leadership experience across enterprise\-scale software engineering environments.
* Deep expertise in modern application architecture, distributed systems, microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), event\-driven architectures, and enterprise software design.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise application development and data architecture, including large\-scale processing, data modeling, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience designing and operating large\-scale application and data platforms using modern messaging, caching, and distributed processing approaches.
* Demonstrated success defining technology strategy, leading complex multi\-team initiatives, and balancing modernization investments with delivery objectives.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision\-making, risk management, reliability, security, and operational excellence capabilities within business\-critical environments.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM) concepts, cloud\-native platforms, observability technologies, automation frameworks, and regulated financial\-services environments.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
