title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction to team**
 The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!
   

  

 The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.
   

  

 We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.
   

  

 If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
* Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
* Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Consultant, Senior Public Health Specialist
description:
PATH current employees \- please log in and apply
 **Here**
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
   

  

**About The Project**
 The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) has launched a dedicated Metropolitan Disease Surveillance Strengthening component under the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM\-ABHIM), covering 20 cities across India. Supported by the World Bank through Transforming India’s Public Health Systems for Pandemic Preparedness Program (PHSPP), PATH has been selected as a key partner by the World Bank in setting up a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to provide expert guidance on this initiative. The TSU will offer technical backstopping and strategic direction during the initial two years of the program, leveraging global experience and best practices. The primary objective is to facilitate the design and implementation of the metropolitan disease surveillance program, address operational challenges, and share insights and innovations as global public goods.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Consultant – Senior Public Health Specialist will play a critical role within the TSU, guiding the strategic implementation, monitoring, and refinement of the metropolitan disease surveillance program. This individual will work closely with national health authorities and stakeholders to ensure the program's success and sustainability.
   

  

* Duty Location: National Centre for Disease Control, Delhi\*\*


**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Provide expert guidance on the design, implementation, and scaling up of the Metropolitan Disease Surveillance program, ensuring alignment with national health priorities and international best practices.
* Support the development and operationalization of surveillance strategies, frameworks, and tools to enhance metropolitan disease surveillance capabilities.
* Identify key enablers and barriers to the successful implementation of the program and propose strategic solutions for overcoming challenges.
* Conduct implementation research, capturing and documenting innovations and best practices, and preparing policy briefs for scaling successful interventions.
* Develop options papers and recommendations on private sector engagement and partnership opportunities to strengthen metropolitan disease surveillance efforts.
* Coordinate with government counterparts, development partners, and technical agencies to ensure integrated and multi\-sectoral approaches to surveillance.
* Geospatial Epidemiology: Study and provide expertise on geospatial epidemiology tools and their application in predicting disease outbreaks and identifying vulnerable populations.
* Contribute to capacity\-building efforts, including training and mentoring of relevant health professionals at national and state levels to enhance surveillance and response systems.
* Prepare and present technical reports, policy briefs, and documentation of key program milestones to the NCDC, the World Bank, and other stakeholders.


**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Education: MBBS with post\-graduate specialization in Community Medicine/Preventive and Social Medicine (PSM) or equivalent.
* Experience:
+ Minimum of 15 years of professional experience in public health, with a strong focus on disease surveillance, public health systems, and program implementation at the national or state level.
+ At least 10 years of hands\-on experience in disease surveillance projects, with a proven track record of leading and managing public health initiatives.

* Sector Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of disease surveillance systems, antimicrobial resistance (AMR), infectious diseases, and public health infrastructure, particularly in urban settings.
* Partnerships: Experience collaborating with national and state health agencies, including NCDC, and IDSP, as well as technical partners such as WHO and CDC, is preferred.


**Essential Skills:**
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Project Management: Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines efficiently.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and familiarity with web\-based research tools.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with government counterparts, donors, and development partners at both national and state levels.
* Health Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with the Indian health system, particularly disease surveillance initiatives such as IHIP, IDSP, and key national programs like NHM, Ayushman Bharat, PM\-ABHIM, and the XV\-FC.
* Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time for program\-related activities.

title: LIC AGENT [on commission based model]
description:
**Company Description** 
 Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is a state\-owned insurance group and investment company headquartered in Mumbai. Established in 1956 through the nationalization of 245 private insurance companies and provident societies, LIC has grown into India’s largest life insurer by policy volume. The organization plays a key role in providing financial protection and long\-term savings solutions to individuals and families across the country. LIC is known for its extensive network, strong brand presence, and commitment to serving diverse customer segments.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, commission\-based LIC Agent role that can be performed remotely. The LIC Agent is responsible for identifying prospective clients, explaining LIC’s life insurance and investment products, and recommending suitable plans based on clients’ financial goals and protection needs. Daily activities include meeting or contacting clients, conducting needs assessments, preparing and submitting proposals, assisting customers with policy documentation, and following up on renewals and service requests. The role also involves maintaining accurate records of client interactions, staying updated on LIC products and regulatory guidelines, and participating in training or marketing initiatives to grow the portfolio. Successful agents build long\-term relationships with clients, support them through claim processes when needed, and contribute to LIC’s overall mission of financial security.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Insurance Sales and Insurance Brokerage skills, with the ability to match products to client needs.
* Solid understanding of Insurance concepts and Finance fundamentals relevant to life insurance and investments.
* Excellent Customer Service abilities, including clear communication, empathy, and timely follow\-up.
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented, and comfortable working on a commission\-based model.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and handle multiple client accounts.
* Basic proficiency in digital tools (email, messaging apps, online forms) for remote client engagement.
* Minimum educational qualification as per LIC and regulatory requirements; prior experience in sales or financial services is an advantage.
* Familiarity with local market dynamics and willingness to continuously learn LIC products and compliance norms.

title: Staff Nurse
description:

 Max Healthcare is one of India’s leading healthcare providers, operating 21 facilities with over 6,000 beds and more than 40,000 employees. The organization offers comprehensive medical and surgical services across multiple specialties, with a strong focus on quality clinical outcomes and patient safety. Max Healthcare emphasizes evidence\-based care, advanced technology, and continuous improvement in patient experience. Team members benefit from structured training, professional development opportunities, and the chance to be part of a large, collaborative healthcare network.  The Staff Nurse is responsible for delivering safe, compassionate, and evidence\-based nursing care to patients in an on\-site hospital setting in Preet Vihar. title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

 PURPOSE
   

  

 Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


**Qualifications**
 EXPERIENCE
   

  

 Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations.
   

  

**NICE TO HAVE**
* ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.


 Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.
   

  

**Knowledge \& Skills**
**IT Service Management Knowledge**
* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.


**Technical Knowledge**
* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.


**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**
* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.


 PROFESSION COMPETENCIES
   

  

**Major Incident Leadership:** 
 Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.
   

  

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** 
 Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.
   

  

**Operational Excellence:** 
 Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.
   

  

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** 
 Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.
   

  

**Process Integration:** 
 Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.
   

  

**Transformation \& Improvement:** 
 Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.
   

  

**Stakeholder Leadership:** 
 Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.
   

  

**Data \& Insight:** 
 Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.
   

  

 CORE COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality


**Education \& Qualifications**
* Diploma or certificate in computer science, electronic engineering, telecommunications, or an equivalent local qualification
* Bachelor’s or university degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
* ITIL Foundation Certificate


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex\-Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and
 **Airport Council International** 
 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like
 **Pluralsight** 
 for technology upskilling,
 **Harvard Business Publishing** 
 for people leadership,
 **Stanford** 
 for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
   

  

 🙌
 **Competitive Benefits:** 
 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

title: Food Safety Officer- Nigeria
description:
The Food Safety Officer is responsible for monitoring, controlling, and maintaining food safety standards across all camp catering operations, including food receiving, stores management, kitchen operations, food preparation, and final food service.
 



  





 The role ensures that all food materials are handled safely from arrival at the camp until consumption, in compliance with HACCP principles, ISO 22000 requirements, company procedures, and food safety best practices.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* 1\. Food Safety Procedures \& Documentation
* Develop, implement, and maintain food safety procedures covering receiving, storage, preparation, cooking, service, cleaning, sanitation, pest control, waste management, allergen control, traceability, and product recall
* Maintain food safety manuals, checklists, forms, and records.
* Ensure procedures comply with HACCP and ISO 22000 requirements.
* Review and update procedures when required.
* Food Receiving \& Supplier Control
* Inspect all incoming food materials and supplies.
* Verify product quality, expiry dates, packaging condition, batch information, and delivery temperatures.
* Maintain traceability records.
* Report and control non\-conforming products.
* Food Stores \& Warehouse Control\- Monitor dry, chilled, and frozen storage areas.
* Ensure correct temperature control and monitoring records.
* Verify FIFO/FEFO stock rotation.
* Ensure proper labeling, segregation, and protection of stored food items.
* Monitor hygiene, housekeeping, and pest control standards.
* Kitchen Operations Monitoring\- Conduct daily inspections of kitchen operations.
* Ensure compliance with food hygiene procedures.
* Monitor personal hygiene, food handling practices, cleaning and sanitation, cross\-contamination prevention, and PPE usage
* Food Safety Training\- Provide regular food safety training for kitchen and stores staff.
* Train employees on personal hygiene, HACCP awareness, temperature control, cleaning procedures, storage practices, and food safety best practices.
* Conduct toolbox talks and awareness sessions.
* Monitoring, Audits \& Reporting
* Complete daily food safety inspections and checklists.
* Monitor HACCP records and corrective actions.\- Identify risks and ensure corrective measures are implemented.
* Prepare food safety reports and support audits.



**Qualifications:** 



* University degree in any discipline OR diploma in a food\-related field (Food Science, Food Technology, Nutrition, Microbiology, Hospitality, Catering, or related disciplines).
* Mandatory Certifications:
* HACCP Level 3 Certification.
* ISO 22000 Food Safety Management System Training.
* Minimum 2\-3 years of experience in food safety, catering operations, kitchen operations, or food handling control.
* Experience controlling the complete food chain: receiving, stores, preparation, cooking, and final food service.
* Skills \& Competencies:
* Good knowledge of HACCP principles and food safety practices.
* Ability to create and manage food safety documentation.
* Ability to train and guide kitchen and stores staff.
* Strong inspection, reporting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a multicultural and remote camp environment

 We are looking for an ambitious and creative individual who wants to work closely with the founders and contribute to the real growth of a premium fashion business.

title: Insights Analyst
description:
A client brief lands asking not for a research report but for an answer: should they enter this category, and if so, how. That is the kind of work this role does. A market\-research agency with a mix of domestic and offshore clients has partnered with Flexiple to hire an Insights Analyst who can take a project past the data\-collection stage and into a recommendation the client can actually act on.
 



 You will work across survey data, secondary research, and sometimes a project team's field notes, and your job is to synthesise all of it into a point of view — not just summarise what each source said. Clients on this agency's roster range from domestic FMCG brands to offshore clients who only ever see the final deck, so the same finding often needs to be framed two different ways for two different audiences. Two to six years in market research, consumer insights, or a strategy\-adjacent analytics role is the baseline, ideally including at least one project where your recommendation was the thing presented, not just the data.
 


* Strong synthesis skills across mixed data sources
* Comfortable owning client\-facing recommendations, not just analysis
* Working knowledge of Excel, SPSS, or a similar analysis tool
* Clear, confident written and spoken English
* Able to work hybrid out of Gurugram or Mumbai



 Apply through Flexiple — one application covers this role and any similar insights openings that follow.

title: Associate Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE TEAM:** 




 The Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the Quality Council of India (QCI) is a team of young professionals working to augment the capacity of government bodies in policy making and to formulate high\-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. We function as a high\-impact consulting group within QCI: a fast\-paced, mission\-driven unit whose work sits at the intersection of policy, research and project management.
 



 Our work spans strategic transformation of service lines across QCI's boards and divisions, conceptualisation and launch of new projects and proposals aligned to national priorities, strategic research and advisory on current and emerging policies, quality assurance, and technology\-led transformations, and comprehensive research and assessment studies for central and state government bodies.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY:** 




 As Retail Specialist within the Project Management Unit, you lead market analysis, competitor study, brand strategy, SKU rationalisation and consumer insights across a national retail network. You establish outlet\-level profitability, determine the operating model appropriate to each location, and design a format architecture that supports premium positioning, so that the retail estate ceases to be a net drain and earns its place commercially. You bring a retail practitioner's command of formats, assortment and consumer behaviour to a national transformation.
 



 The role blends retail strategy, consumer insight, and commercial design on a high\-visibility national programme.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY:** 




 You will be at the epicentre of policy and execution, translating the Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision into actionable, on\-the\-ground projects that affect millions of lives, rather than producing reports and opinion pieces alone.
 



 We are looking for individuals who want to look back at their careers and point to a specific national programme and say, 'I helped build that.'  Prior experience with multi\-outlet retail networks, franchise models, omni\-channel retail and premium positioning.

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.
   

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.
   

  

 The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started out as UrbanClap in Nov 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav and Varun realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented and offline. Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 


* Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
* Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
* Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the job :** 




  





 Urban Company is India's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace — operating at scale across cleaning, beauty, wellness, and home maintenance. We're looking for a performance marketer who lives in the bottom of the funnel: someone obsessed with converting high\-intent users into first\-time customers, squeezing CAC, and scaling what works. This role owns UC's paid acquisition engine across Search and Social — the channels that drive real installs and first bookings.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* **Paid Social (Meta):** 
 Run performance\-first Meta campaigns — conversion campaigns, app install campaigns, and dynamic product ads — optimising for CPO and install\-to\-booking rate, not just clicks.
* **UAC / App campaigns:** 
 Manage Google UAC and Meta App Campaigns to drive new installs from high\-intent audiences; optimise in\-app event bidding toward first booking as the conversion goal.
* **Paid Search (SEM):** 
 Own Google Search and PMax campaigns end\-to\-end — keyword strategy, match types, bid management, Quality Score optimisation, and ad copy testing — with a relentless focus on driving high\-intent traffic that converts to first bookings.
* **CAC \& efficiency management:** 
 Set and manage CAC targets by channel and category; build spend pacing models to maximise new user volume within efficiency guardrails.
* **Audience \& targeting:** 
 Build high\-intent audience segments using keyword intent signals, platform behavioural data, and first\-party CRM lists; run retargeting flows to recapture drop\-offs in the install\-to\-booking funnel.
* **Landing page \& conversion optimisation:** 
 Partner with product to identify and fix conversion bottlenecks between ad click → app install → first booking; brief and test landing page variants to improve post\-click CVR.
* **Attribution \& MMP management:** 
 Own AppsFlyer/Adjust setup — campaign tagging, event mapping, cohort reporting, and fraud monitoring — to ensure clean, accurate new user attribution across channels.
* **Creative for performance:** 
 Brief and iterate on direct\-response creatives (static, carousel, search copy); run structured A/B tests on offers, CTAs, and formats; kill what doesn't convert fast.
* **Reporting \& forecasting:** 
 Maintain weekly performance dashboards (CPO, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, CAC by channel); build forward\-looking acquisition forecasts tied to spend scenarios.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience at a consumer internet company, D2C brand, or digital agency — with a clear track record of driving new user/customer acquisition through paid Search and Social.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Google Ads (UAC, Search, PMax) and Meta Ads Manager (conversion campaigns, app installs, dynamic ads).
* Strong command of bottom\-funnel metrics: CAC, CPO, CPI, ROAS, install\-to\-booking rate, first\-order conversion rate, and payback period.
* Experience managing MMP platforms (AppsFlyer or Adjust) — event setup, attribution windows, cohort analysis, and fraud detection.
* Analytically strong: able to build CAC forecasts and channel mix models in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL is a strong plus.
* Bias for action: comfortable making fast, data\-backed decisions on bids, budgets, and creative — without waiting for perfect information.
* Graduation from a Tier 1/2 institute.



  





**Why join Urban Company** 




 This is a high\-ownership role at the sharp end of UC's growth. You'll have real budget, real data, and real accountability for new user numbers — with the cross\-functional support to move fast. If you're a performance marketer who wants to own outcomes rather than manage reports, this is your seat.
 



*Urban Company is committed to equal and fair opportunities in employment and an inclusive, harassment\-free work environment for all.*

title: Sr. Growth Lead ( Paid Social ) |  A leading digital health & E-pharmacy platform
description:
**About the Company:** 




  





 The organization is a healthcare platform for humans, designed for real life. It is a leading online pharmacy \& medical care platform, re\-imagining healthcare to make it accessible, affordable and entirely human. Driven by their passion for innovation and customer\-care, they have designed a suite of digital care experiences that empower their members to take control of their health wherever life takes them. Powered by pharmacists, engineers, doctors, clinicians \& service experts, their platform redefines the world of wellness, from personalized treatment that actually feels personal, to truly effortless medicine delivery.
 



  





  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for a heavyweight Media Buyer to lead our paid social and emerging channel strategy. You are a data\-obsessed, platform\-native growth marketer who lives in Ads Manager but thinks in "Creative Hooks." You’ve likely managed millions in spend for multiple DTC clients at a top agency and are now ready to focus your expertise on scaling a single, high\-impact brand. You don't just follow best practices; you define them.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Channel Ownership** 



* Full Meta \+ TikTok account ownership — strategy, architecture, execution, results
* Budget pacing and allocation decisions are yours. You manage to the target.
* Daily optimization with documented rationale.



  





**2\. Diagnosis \& Troubleshooting** 



* When performance drops: check pixel health, CAPI event quality, UTM consistency, and the full conversion flow — before touching campaign settings.
* Use Clarity (or equivalent) to watch real user sessions — spot drop\-off, rage clicks, and form friction that no dashboard shows
* Reconcile Meta/TikT ok data against internal analytics (Mixpanel \& Tableau) and GA4\.
* Know which number to trust and why.



  





**3\. Creative Strategy \& Feedback Loop** 



* The Creative Bridge: You consume social content relentlessly. You know what’s trending on TikTok before it hits the mainstream. You will provide the "Performance Filter" for our creative team, identifying which hooks, visual styles, and CTAs are winning.
* Direct Response Copy: Write and iterate on high\-converting ad copy that balances healthcare credibility with DTC "scroll\-stopping" urgency. You will work with our creative strategist to make sure our creatives are always ahead of the curve.



  





**4\. Strategy \& Measurement** 



* Contribute to growth planning — not as an executor but as someone with a point of view.
* Own attribution infrastructure: Meta CAPI, TikT ok Events API, GA4, UTM hygiene.
* Build and maintain the reporting framework the team actually uses.



  





**Required Skills** 




  





**1\. Strategy \& Measurement** 



* Problems get fixed before anyone asks you to fix them.
* You bring recommendations with problems, not just problems.
* High autonomy environments are where you do your best work.



  





**2\. You are genuinely technical** 



* You've set up or verified CAPI, UTM parameters, and GA4 events — hands\-on, not directed.
* Session recordings are a regular diagnostic tool, not something you open once a quarter.
* When data doesn't add up, you investigate. When it adds up too neatly, you're skeptical.



  





**3\. You make creative teams better** 



* Your briefs are specific enough that the first draft is close.
* You give feedback in terms of the problem to solve, not the execution to copy.
* You translate between performance data and creative instinct — fluently.



  





**Must Haves** 




  




* 4–7 years hands\-on paid social — you built campaigns, not supervised them.
* Individually managing Meta full\-funnel at $100K\+/month with direct CPA accountability.
* Personally diagnosed and fixed a pixel, tracking, or attribution problem.
* Personally briefed creative — specific enough to get good work on the first draft.
* Active user of Clarity, Hotjar, or equivalent session recording tools.
* Able to reconcile platform data with Ad platform / GA4 and explain discrepancies.
* Strong written English — briefs, performance docs, stakeholder updates.



  





  





**Strong Advantages** 




  




* TikTok hands\-on — Spark Ads, Events API, creative\-first strategy.
* Regulated category experience (healthcare, pharma, finance, insurance).
* Canadian market knowledge — cultural context, French\-English dynamics.
* Third\-party attribution: Triple Whale, Northbeam, Rockerbox, or similar.
* UGC creator briefing and Spark Ad authorization workflows.
* Built a creative testing system from scratch.



  





  





**About WinnerBrands** 




  





 At WinnerBrands, we are on a mission to create a community of the brightest marketing minds to deliver impactful, rewarding, and purposeful work by collaborating, contributing \& co\-learning with smart peers. Backed by Busybeebrands.com, a pioneering brand\-building firm that has helped some of the most disruptive new\-age brands in the country craft their brand and marketing strategy, we find opportunities with progressives startups and brands in the domain of marketing with multiple engagement models for our talent partners, freelance / part\-time or full\-time.  .

description:
\- First 6\-8 weeks Timing 6pm to 3pm for training purpose.
 



  





 Location \- Gurugram, Bengaluru, Pune, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Chennai
 



  





 Maximum Budget \- 11 LPA
 



**Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Administrator** 




 Position Summary
 



 The IAM Junior Administrator supports the management of user identities, access privileges, authentication systems, and cloud identity services across the organization's IT environment. This role assists in user provisioning, access reviews, compliance activities, AWS IAM administration, and troubleshooting access\-related issues while ensuring adherence to security policies and regulatory requirements.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 User Access Management
 


* Create, modify, and disable user accounts across enterprise systems and applications.
* Process access requests in accordance with established policies and approval workflows.
* Perform user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding activities.
* Maintain role\-based access controls (RBAC) and user group memberships.
* Help provision and deprovision access across enterprise systems and cloud platforms.



 Identity Administration
 


* Support the administration of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, or similar identity platforms.
* Manage password resets, account unlocks, and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment.
* Assist with Single Sign\-On (SSO) configuration and troubleshooting.
* Document IAM configurations, procedures, and operational processes.



 AWS Identity \& Access Management
 


* Assist in creating and managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of least\-privilege access controls.
* Help manage IAM roles for AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, RDS, and other cloud resources.
* Troubleshoot basic AWS access issues, including permission errors, policy conflicts, and role assumption problems.
* Support access provisioning and deprovisioning within AWS environments.
* Maintain documentation of AWS IAM configurations, standards, and procedures.



 Access Governance \& Compliance
 


* Conduct periodic user access reviews and certification campaigns.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Maintain accurate documentation of access control procedures and user permissions.
* Support internal and external audits by providing access\-related evidence and reports.
* Assist in monitoring privileged access and segregation of duties controls.



 Incident \& Problem Management
 


* Investigate and resolve identity and access\-related incidents.
* Escalate complex issues to senior IAM administrators or security teams.
* Monitor IAM systems and identify potential security concerns.
* Participate in root\-cause analysis for recurring access issues.



 Reporting \& Documentation
 


* Generate reports on user access, privileged accounts, and compliance metrics.
* Maintain IAM operational procedures, knowledge base articles, and process documentation.
* Track and document service requests through ticketing systems.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field; or equivalent work experience.



**Experience** 



* 0–4 years of experience in IT support, system administration, cybersecurity, cloud administration, or IAM\-related roles.
* Experience working with ticketing systems and IT service management processes is preferred.



**Technical Skills** 



* Basic understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts.
* Familiarity with:
* Microsoft Active Directory
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* LDAP
* Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* Single Sign\-On (SSO)
* Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM)
* AWS Management Console and basic AWS CLI usage
* Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, and cloud environments.
* Basic understanding of PowerShell, Python, or other scripting languages is a plus.
* Experience with IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, Ping Identity, Saviynt, or similar solutions is advantageous.



**Security Knowledge** 



* Understanding of:
* Least Privilege principles
* Segregation of Duties (SoD)
* Access governance
* User lifecycle management
* Identity security best practices
* Cloud security fundamentals and AWS IAM concepts



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Customer\-service mindset and ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 



* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty (preferred)



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Timely completion of user provisioning and deprovisioning requests.
* Compliance with access review schedules.
* Accuracy of user access assignments.
* Resolution time for IAM\-related incidents and requests.
* Audit findings related to identity and access controls.
* Compliance with AWS IAM security standards and least\-privilege requirements.

description:
**Job Description – Front Office Associate \| Z Hotels \| Zolo** 




**Be the first smile. Be the calm in the chaos. Be the reason guests return.** 




  





**Company Name:** 
 ZoloStays
 



**Business Unit:** 
 ZHotels

 : Front Office Associate
 



**Location** 
 : Bengaluru

 On\-duty meals provided

 Full\-time

 Freshers / 0–2 years in hospitality, front office, or
 



 customer\-facing roles
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Z Hotels is scaling deliberately. As we grow, maintaining a 4\.9\+ guest experience across hotels is non\-negotiable. At Z Hotels, the front desk is not a counter. It is the heartbeat of the hotel. Before guests experience the room, the food, or the city — they experience you.
 



  





**This role exists to ensure:** 




 ● Every guest feels welcomed with warmth
 



 ● Every check\-in and check\-out feels smooth
 



 ● Every request is handled with care and speed
 



 ● Every interaction feels personal
 



 This is not a check\-in role. It is an experience\-building role.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear:** 




 ● Ensure every guest interaction reflects warmth, speed, and professionalism
 



 ● Contribute to maintaining a 4\.9\+ guest rating through consistent front office excellence
 



 ● Eliminate avoidable friction in check\-in, check\-out, and request handling
 



 ● Build guest loyalty through personalisation and thoughtful service.
 



 If you believe small gestures create big memories — this role is for you.
 



  





**About Zolo and Z Hotels** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent. People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifiesurban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational
 



 discipline.
 



 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for:** 




 At the front desk, excellence is built through four everyday commitments:
 



 1\. Be the Smile They Remember
 



 You’ll:
 



 ● Greet every guest with genuine warmth
 



 ● Maintain calm, positive body language
 



 ● Handle difficult moments with grace
 



 ● Keep the front desk welcoming and organised
 



 When you do this well — guests walk away smiling.
 



 2\. Make Every Interaction Seamless
 



 You’ll:
 



 ● Complete check\-ins and check\-outs efficiently
 



 ● Respond to queries without unnecessary delay
 



 ● Coordinate quickly with other departments
 



 ● Stay composed even during busy hours
 



 When you do this well — guests describe the hotel as effortless.
 



 3\. Create Small “Wow” Moments
 



 You’ll:
 



 ● Offer help before being asked
 



 ● Suggest thoughtful local tips or hotel offerings
 



 ● Turn complaints into opportunities to impress
 



 ● Notice small details others might miss
 



 When you do this well — guests leave glowing reviews.
 



 4\. Make It Personal
 



 You’ll:
 



 ● Remember repeat guests
 



 ● Learn preferences and record them
 



 ● Adapt your tone and communication style
 



 ● Treat every guest like an individual
 



 When you do this well — guests don’t just stay. They return.
 



  





**What success looks like:** 




 ● Guests consistently mention warmth and professionalism in reviews
 



 ● Check\-ins and requests are handled efficiently
 



 ● Escalations reduce due to calm handling
 



 ● Repeat guests feel recognised and comfortable
 



 ● Front office contributes strongly to 4\.8\+ rating performance
 



  





**Who this role is for:** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 



 ● You genuinely enjoy interacting with people
 



 ● You stay calm under pressure
 



 ● You notice small details others ignore
 



 ● You take pride in professionalism and presentation
 



 ● You believe service is a craft
 



  





**What we look for:** 




 ● Fresh graduates beginning their careers
 



 ● Strong communication skills and confident presence
 



 ● Professional grooming and discipline
 



 ● Willingness to learn through structured training
 



 No prior hotel experience is required. We hire for attitude, warmth, and discipline —
 



 and train for the rest.
 



  





**The impact you will have:** 




 ● You will shape how guests feel the moment they enter.
 



 ● You will influence reviews, loyalty, and reputation.
 



 ● And you will help ensure Z Hotels scales without losing its human touch.
 



  





**Why join now:** 




 Z Hotels is in a growth phase. As we scale, the front office will define whether we
 



 grow with soul or just with size.
 



 If you care about making people feel welcome — this is the right moment.

title: Founders’ Office
description:
**Founder's Office \| Growth Valley Community** 




 Gurugram (in\-office) \| Full\-time \| 1\-5 years experience \| Reports directly to the Founder
 



  





 Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.
 



  





 Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A
 **consistent** 
 growth story will be awarded.
 



  





**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.** 




  





**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.** 




  





**About GVC.** 




  





 Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000\+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.
 



  





 Product\-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.
 



  





**The role.** 




  





 You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.
 



  





 This is the highest\-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.
 



  





**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:** 




  




* **Enrollment engine.** 
 Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.



  




* **Admissions product.** 
 We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.



  




* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1\.** 
 A new one\-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.



  




* **Partnerships.** 
 Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.



  




* **The numbers.** 
 Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.



  





**How we will measure you.** 




 Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.
 



  





**Who fits.** 



* Tier\-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1\-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.



  





**Who should not apply.** 




  





 If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.
 



  





**Compensation.** 




  





 fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG\-level.
 



  





**Growth path.** 




  





 This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.
 



  





**How to apply.** 




  





 Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com
 


1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.



 Subject line: FO \| Your Name \| College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.
